title: Strategies for Deploying AI Agents in Production at Scientific User Facilities
title_zh: 生产AI代理在科学用户设施中的部署策略

paragraphs.en: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is moving beyond research demonstrations toward production use at scientific user facilities, including light sources, neutron sources, nanoscience centers, and autonomous laboratories. Its scientific value extends beyond increasing throughput. Agents can perform repeatable tasks in calibration, measurement execution, and quality control, as well as initial analyses that turn data into reviewable evidence, allowing scientists to focus on hypotheses, unexpected observations, and interpretation. Drawing on deployments of large language model (LLM) -driven agents at the Advanced Photon Source (APS) , this perspective distills practical strategies with an emphasis on elements that can be reused across instruments and facilities. We discuss agent harnesses for beamline control, facility knowledge retrieval, and data analysis while keeping the underlying design principles independent of any specific implementation. These principles cover inference endpoints, tool-server architectures, non-text data, computationally intensive services, reusable skills, and governed learning throughout an instrument’s lifecycle. We also consider how network and Linux operations, governed shared memory, and deterministic orchestration can extend these patterns across facility services. Because LLM capabilities continue to evolve, these recommendations represent a snapshot of the technology as of the date on the cover.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体人工智能（AI）正从研究演示阶段迈向科学用户设施的生产性应用，包括光源、中子源、纳米科学中心和自主实验室。 其科学价值不仅体现在提升处理通量上。 智能体能够执行校准、测量执行和质量控制中的可重复任务，以及将数据转化为可供审查的证据的初步分析，从而让科学家专注于假设、意外观察和解释。 本视角基于先进光子源（APS）中大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体的部署经验，提炼出实用策略，并重点强调可在不同仪器和设施间重复使用的要素。 我们讨论了用于束线控制、设施知识检索和数据分析的智能体工具集，同时确保其底层设计原则不依赖于任何具体实现方式。 这些原则涵盖了推理端点、工具服务器架构、非文本数据、计算密集型服务、可重复使用的技能，以及在整个仪器生命周期中的受控学习。 我们还探讨了网络与 Linux 操作、受管理的共享内存和确定性编排如何将这些模式扩展到设施的各项服务中。 由于大型语言模型的能力持续演进，这些建议反映了截至封面所示日期的技术现状。

paragraphs.en: Three converging trends have made agentic AI a credible production technology for scientific user facilities. First, recent LLMs provide reliable tool use, coding-based problem solving, multimodal reasoning, and the ability to follow task-specific instructions. Second, modern instrument-control stacks expose well-defined programmable interfaces, such as Bluesky/Ophyd connected to the Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System (EPICS) , through which agents can interact with instruments. Third, the growing adoption of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a common interface for different harnesses to discover and invoke tools [ 1 ] . Consequently, interactive natural-language control, autonomous execution of bounded procedures, and on-the-fly interpretation of multimodal data are becoming deployable capabilities rather than isolated prototypes. The remaining engineering question is how to deploy these capabilities effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 三种趋同的趋势使智能体驱动的人工智能成为科学用户设施中一种可信的生产技术。 首先，近期的语言模型（LLM）具备可靠的工具使用能力、基于编码的问题解决能力、多模态推理能力以及遵循特定任务指令的能力。 其次，现代仪器控制栈提供了定义明确的可编程接口，例如与实验物理和工业控制系统（EPICS）相连的 Bluesky/Ophyd，智能体可以通过这些接口与仪器进行交互。 第三，模型上下文协议（MCP）的日益普及为不同的工具调用框架提供了通用接口，使其能够发现并调用工具 [1]。 因此，交互式自然语言控制、有限流程的自主执行以及对多模态数据的即时解读，正逐渐转变为可部署的实际能力，而非孤立的原型。 剩下的工程问题在于如何有效部署这些能力。

paragraphs.en: The motivation, however, is not simply to perform more measurements per hour. As instruments and experiments become more capable, scientists devote increasing attention to routine setup, calibration, monitoring, data handling, and recovery from familiar failure modes. An assistant that performs these bounded technical tasks and connects measurements to documentation and validated analysis can shorten the path from data to reviewable evidence, allowing scientists to focus on experimental intent and scientific judgment. When corrections, decisions, and outcomes are retained with their provenance, the system can also accumulate knowledge throughout the instrument operational lifecycle: scientists teach procedures and exceptions to the system, which can later return explanations and operational knowledge to new users. Retrieval-augmented facility assistants, teachable instrument agents, and vision-language experiment automation provide early examples of these complementary roles [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，其动机并非仅仅是每小时执行更多测量。 随着仪器和实验能力的提升，科学家越来越关注常规设置、校准、监测、数据处理以及应对常见的故障模式。 一种能够执行这些有限技术任务，并将测量结果与文档及验证过的分析相连接的助手，可以缩短从数据到可供审查证据的路径，使科学家能专注于实验意图和科学判断。 当修正、决策和结果与其来源一同保留时，该系统还能够在整个仪器运行生命周期中积累知识：科学家向系统传授程序和例外情况，而系统后来也能向新用户提供解释和操作知识。 检索增强型设施助手、可教学的仪器智能体以及视觉-语言实验自动化技术，为这些互补角色提供了早期范例 [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。

sents.en: Retrieval-augmented facility assistants, teachable instrument agents, and vision-language experiment automation provide early examples of these complementary roles [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] .

paragraphs.en: Several systems have established what agentic AI can provide at scientific facilities. The Context-Aware Language Model for Science (CALMS) [ 2 ] demonstrated retrieval- and tool-augmented LLMs as facility assistants by combining semantic search of documentation with direct instrument-control calls. VISION [ 5 ] introduced a modular “cog” architecture and reported a voice-controlled experiment at the Complex Materials Scattering beamline of the National Synchrotron Light Source II. Vriza et al. [ 3 ] demonstrated a multimodal, teachable multi-agent system for operating the Hard X-ray Nanoprobe and a robotic synthesis platform, with human feedback retained as retrievable memory. Osprey [ 6 ] packages agentic AI for production deployment in safety-critical control systems. Ptychographic Experiment and Analysis Robot (PEAR) [ 7 ] converts natural-language ptychography requests into validated reconstruction scripts, while Experiment Automation Agents (EAA) [ 4 ] supports workflows ranging from interactive sessions to deterministic logic with embedded LLM queries. These projects address different aspects of agentic operation; here, we consider how to translate their demonstrations into routine practice across the APS and other facilities.
paragraphs.zh: 已有多个系统明确了智能体型人工智能在科研设施中能够提供哪些功能。 《科学领域情境感知语言模型》（CALMS）[ 2 ] 通过将文献的语义搜索与直接的设备控制调用相结合，展示了具备检索增强和工具增强功能的语言大模型如何作为设施助手发挥作用。 VISION [ 5 ] 提出了一种模块化的“齿轮”架构，并报告了在国家同步辐射光源 II 的复杂材料散射光束线上进行的一项语音控制实验。Vriza 等人 [ 3 ] 展示了一个多模态、可教学的智能体系统，用于操作硬X射线纳米探针和机器人合成平台，同时保留了人类反馈作为可检索的记忆。 Osprey [ 6 ] 将智能体型人工智能封装为可在安全关键控制系统中投入生产部署的模块。 相干衍射成像实验与分析机器人（PEAR）[ 7 ] 能够将自然语言形式的相干衍射成像请求转换为经过验证的重建脚本，而实验自动化智能体（EAA）[ 4 ] 则支持从交互式会话到包含嵌入式语言大模型查询的确定性逻辑等多种工作流程。 这些项目涉及智能体操作的不同方面；在此，我们将探讨如何将它们的演示成果转化为美国物理学会同步辐射实验室及其他设施的常规实践。

paragraphs.en: We distill this strategy from deployments that span instrument control at the 26-ID hard X-ray nanoprobe [ 3 ] and the 2-ID-D microprobe endstation [ 4 ] , retrieval from electronic logbooks and technical documents, and analysis of X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) , high-energy diffraction microscopy (HEDM) , and ptychographic data [ 7 ] . Appendix A collects the named implementations and examples of their interfaces, whereas the main text is organized around the functions that these systems provide. We first present the design principles and then describe recommended practices for inference endpoints, tool servers, data handling, computation, and skill decomposition. We extend these practices to network and Linux operations, shared knowledge and memory, and orchestration across facility services before presenting the worked nanoprobe demonstration. These recommendations are independent of a specific harness. Finally, we identify both immediate facility needs and longer-term opportunities for scientific user facilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从覆盖 26-ID 硬 X 射线纳米探针 [3] 和 2-ID-D 微探针终端站 [4] 的设备控制部署、电子日志和技术文档的检索，以及对 X 射线吸收光谱（XAS）、高能衍射显微镜（HEDM）和ptychographic 数据的分析 [7] 中提炼出这一策略。 附录 A 汇总了已命名的实现方案及其接口的示例，而正文则围绕这些系统提供的功能进行组织。 我们首先介绍设计原则，然后描述推理端点、工具服务器、数据处理、计算和技能分解方面的推荐实践。 在展示纳米探针的实际演示之前，我们将这些实践扩展到网络和 Linux 操作、共享知识与记忆，以及设施服务之间的协调。 这些建议与特定的集成框架无关。 最后，我们识别了科学用户设施的即时需求以及更长期的机遇。

paragraphs.zh: 各束线中的仪器与加速器控制

paragraphs.en: Access to leadership-class computing through services such as the Integrated Research Infrastructure (IRI) , Globus Compute, and MCP tools
paragraphs.zh: 通过集成研究基础设施（IRI）、Globus Compute 和 MCP 工具等服务，获取领导级计算资源

paragraphs.en: The hub connects any agent harness that follows the MCP contract to instruments and services that provide or use these capabilities. Computationally intensive workloads outside the instrument environment are attached as external services. Current examples include Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) inference and Pty-Chi ptychographic reconstruction on the Polaris leadership-class system at the Argonne Leadership Computing Facility (ALCF) , as well as model training in a commercial cloud. Figure 1 therefore presents the capabilities of the architecture rather than a complete operational stack. Identity and authorization, physical safety, observability, provenance, evaluation, and lifecycle learning remain requirements across every spoke. Sections 2 – 3.2.4 explain how the design principles determine these components, Section 4 shows how one instrument-control spoke is implemented at the 26-ID nanoprobe, and Section 5 outlines the capabilities that remain to be developed.
paragraphs.zh: 该中心枢纽将任何遵循 MCP 合约的智能体框架，与提供或使用这些能力的仪器和服务连接起来。 位于仪器环境之外、计算密集型的工作负载则作为外部服务接入。 当前的示例包括在阿贡领导力计算设施（ALCF）的 Polaris 领导级系统上运行“万物分割模型 3”（SAM3）推理和 Pty-Chi 相干衍射成像重建，以及在商业云中进行模型训练。 因此，图 1 展示的是该架构的能力，而非一个完整的运行堆栈。 身份与授权、物理安全、可观测性、来源追溯、评估以及生命周期学习，仍然是每个分支的通用需求。 第 2 至 3.2.4 节将解释设计原则如何确定这些组件；第 4 节展示了在 26-ID 纳米探针上实现一个仪器控制分支的具体方式；第 5 节则概述了尚待开发的能力。

paragraphs.en: The four capability categories also depend on shared network, Linux, storage, and service infrastructure. Sections 3.4 – 3.6 extend the architecture to operational support for these dependencies, a governed knowledge and memory service, and orchestration over deterministic execution interfaces. These are cross-cutting extensions rather than additional instrument-specific spokes. A unified control plane should provide consistent discovery, resource identity, and task and result contracts while preserving the authority of each underlying system. A capability catalog is therefore one component of this design, not a substitute for its runtime controls.
paragraphs.zh: 这四大能力类别也依赖于共享网络、Linux、存储和服务基础设施。 第 3.4 – 3.6 节将架构扩展至对这些依赖项的操作支持、受管的知识与记忆服务，以及对确定性执行接口的编排。 这些是跨领域的扩展，而非针对特定设备的额外分支。 统一的控制平面应提供一致的服务发现、资源标识以及任务与结果契约，同时保留每个底层系统的自主权。 因此，能力目录是该设计的一个组成部分，而非其运行时控制机制的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Choose an LLM inference service that is accessible from the computer on which the agentic application is deployed. To reduce operational complexity, we recommend deploying the application on a computer with direct access to the instrument control interfaces. These computers typically reside on an isolated private network. Inference services accessible from devices on this network may include institutionally provided models, e.g. , Argo at Argonne, and/or self-hosted local LLMs .
paragraphs.zh: 选择一个可以从部署智能体应用程序的计算机上访问的大型语言模型推理服务。 为降低操作复杂性，我们建议将应用程序部署在可以直接访问仪器控制接口的计算机上。 这些计算机通常位于一个隔离的私有网络中。 可从该网络设备访问的推理服务可能包括机构提供的模型（例如，阿贡国家实验室的 Argo），和/或本地自托管的大型语言模型。

sents.zh: 选择一个可以从部署智能体应用程序的计算机上访问的大型语言模型推理服务。

sents.zh: 为降低操作复杂性，我们建议将应用程序部署在可以直接访问仪器控制接口的计算机上。

paragraphs.en: Decouple the agent harness from low-level control routines and/or data processing packages. Building these tools directly into the harness forces them to share dependencies, making the environment difficult to resolve and maintain. This is particularly problematic with instruments having specialized requirements, such as legacy x86 libraries or older Python interpreters. Coupling tools to a specific harness also limits their reuse by other harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 将智能体框架与底层控制程序和/或数据处理包解耦。 若将这些工具直接集成到框架中，就会迫使它们共享依赖项，导致环境难以解析和维护。 对于具有特殊需求的设备而言，这一问题尤为突出，例如需要旧版 x86 库或旧版 Python 解释器的设备。 将工具与特定框架耦合，也会限制其他框架对其的复用。

sents.en: Decouple the agent harness from low-level control routines and/or data processing packages.
sents.zh: 将智能体框架与底层控制程序和/或数据处理包解耦。

sents.en: Building these tools directly into the harness forces them to share dependencies, making the environment difficult to resolve and maintain.
sents.zh: 若将这些工具直接集成到框架中，就会迫使它们共享依赖项，导致环境难以解析和维护。

sents.en: This is particularly problematic with instruments having specialized requirements, such as legacy x86 libraries or older Python interpreters.
sents.zh: 对于具有特殊需求的设备而言，这一问题尤为突出，例如需要旧版 x86 库或旧版 Python 解释器的设备。

sents.en: Coupling tools to a specific harness also limits their reuse by other harnesses.
sents.zh: 将工具与特定框架耦合，也会限制其他框架对其的复用。

paragraphs.en: Ensure interoperability between tools and control libraries. For example, some control libraries manage their own asynchronous event loops or thread pools. Tool integrations should be designed so that thread-safety or asynchronous-execution issues do not crash the program. In addition, parallel tool calls may have unpredictable consequences when they operate real instruments. The best engineering practice is to implement guards that mark instruments or facilities as unavailable and reject further commands issued to busy objects. For example, the accelerator control software has some “run-control” process variables (PVs) that indicate hardware being modified by another process, and prevents the launch of new automated processes. However, guards on the agentic harness level should still be implemented to avoid asynchronous or multi-threaded executions of vulnerable equipments.
paragraphs.zh: 确保工具与控制库之间的互操作性。 例如，某些控制库会自行管理异步事件循环或线程池。 工具集成应经过设计，以避免线程安全或异步执行问题导致程序崩溃。 此外，当并行调用工具操作真实仪器时，可能会产生不可预测的后果。 最佳工程实践是实施保护机制，将仪器或设备标记为不可用，并拒绝向忙碌对象发出进一步命令。 例如，加速器控制软件中有一些“运行控制”过程变量（PV），用于指示硬件正被其他进程修改，并防止启动新的自动化进程。 然而，仍应在智能体框架层面实施保护机制，以避免对易受攻击的设备进行异步或多线程执行。

sents.en: Ensure interoperability between tools and control libraries.
sents.zh: 确保工具与控制库之间的互操作性。

sents.en: For example, some control libraries manage their own asynchronous event loops or thread pools.
sents.zh: 例如，某些控制库会自行管理异步事件循环或线程池。

sents.en: Tool integrations should be designed so that thread-safety or asynchronous-execution issues do not crash the program.
sents.zh: 工具集成应经过设计，以避免线程安全或异步执行问题导致程序崩溃。

sents.en: In addition, parallel tool calls may have unpredictable consequences when they operate real instruments.
sents.zh: 此外，当并行调用工具操作真实仪器时，可能会产生不可预测的后果。

sents.en: The best engineering practice is to implement guards that mark instruments or facilities as unavailable and reject further commands issued to busy objects.
sents.zh: 最佳工程实践是实施保护机制，将仪器或设备标记为不可用，并拒绝向忙碌对象发出进一步命令。

sents.en: For example, the accelerator control software has some “run-control” process variables (PVs) that indicate hardware being modified by another process, and prevents the launch of new automated processes.
sents.zh: 例如，加速器控制软件中有一些“运行控制”过程变量（PV），用于指示硬件正被其他进程修改，并防止启动新的自动化进程。

sents.en: However, guards on the agentic harness level should still be implemented to avoid asynchronous or multi-threaded executions of vulnerable equipments.
sents.zh: 然而，仍应在智能体框架层面实施保护机制，以避免对易受攻击的设备进行异步或多线程执行。

paragraphs.en: Promote tool reusability. Tools should be reusable across agent harnesses whenever possible. This goal further motivates decoupling tools from harnesses and using a common standard, such as the MCP [ 1 ] , for harness-tool communication.
paragraphs.zh: 促进工具的重复使用性。 工具应尽可能在不同智能体框架之间重复使用。 这一目标进一步推动了将工具与框架解耦，并采用通用标准（例如 MCP [ 1 ]）来实现框架与工具之间的通信。

sents.en: Promote tool reusability.
sents.zh: 促进工具的重复使用性。

sents.en: Tools should be reusable across agent harnesses whenever possible.
sents.zh: 工具应尽可能在不同智能体框架之间重复使用。

sents.en: This goal further motivates decoupling tools from harnesses and using a common standard, such as the MCP [ 1 ] , for harness-tool communication.
sents.zh: 这一目标进一步推动了将工具与框架解耦，并采用通用标准（例如 MCP [ 1 ]）来实现框架与工具之间的通信。

paragraphs.en: Unify access without conflating authority. Use reviewed, deterministic adapters to connect disparate systems through explicit request and result contracts. The orchestrator should retain task and dependency state, execution services should enforce local permissions and report operational outcomes, and shared memory should retain scoped evidence and reusable knowledge. An agent’s plan, remembered approval, or completion statement must not replace the corresponding execution or authorization record.
paragraphs.zh: 统一访问权限，但不可混淆授权关系。 使用经过审查且确定性的适配器，通过明确的需求与结果契约连接异构系统。 协调器应保留任务与依赖状态，执行服务应强制实施本地权限并报告运行结果，共享内存则应保留作用域内的证据和可重用的知识。 智能体的计划、已批准的记录或完成声明不得替代相应的执行或授权记录。

sents.en: Unify access without conflating authority.
sents.zh: 统一访问权限，但不可混淆授权关系。

sents.en: Use reviewed, deterministic adapters to connect disparate systems through explicit request and result contracts.
sents.zh: 使用经过审查且确定性的适配器，通过明确的需求与结果契约连接异构系统。

sents.en: The orchestrator should retain task and dependency state, execution services should enforce local permissions and report operational outcomes, and shared memory should retain scoped evidence and reusable knowledge.
sents.zh: 协调器应保留任务与依赖状态，执行服务应强制实施本地权限并报告运行结果，共享内存则应保留作用域内的证据和可重用的知识。

sents.en: An agent’s plan, remembered approval, or completion statement must not replace the corresponding execution or authorization record.
sents.zh: 智能体的计划、已批准的记录或完成声明不得替代相应的执行或授权记录。

paragraphs.en: Ensure the physical safety of tool execution. Tools must include guardrails that prevent erroneous agent calls from damaging instruments or creating safety hazards. Do not rely on the agent to enforce physical safety boundaries. Unless these boundaries are enforced at the firmware or control-library level, tool developers should implement explicit validation and operational limits within the tool package. Agent actuation requires exclusive control authority and remains subject to immediate operator override. The agent is further restricted by capability gating and command-rate limits, so only approved classes of commands may be issued.
paragraphs.zh: 确保工具执行过程中的物理安全。 工具必须包含防护机制，防止错误的智能体调用损坏设备或引发安全隐患。 不要依赖智能体来强制执行物理安全边界。 除非这些边界在固件或控制库层面得到强制执行，否则工具开发者应在工具包中实施明确的验证和运行限制。 智能体的执行需要独占的控制权限，但仍可被操作员即时覆盖。 智能体还受到能力门控和命令速率限制的限制，因此只能发出经批准的命令类别。

sents.en: Ensure the physical safety of tool execution.
sents.zh: 确保工具执行过程中的物理安全。

sents.en: Tools must include guardrails that prevent erroneous agent calls from damaging instruments or creating safety hazards.
sents.zh: 工具必须包含防护机制，防止错误的智能体调用损坏设备或引发安全隐患。

sents.en: Do not rely on the agent to enforce physical safety boundaries.
sents.zh: 不要依赖智能体来强制执行物理安全边界。

sents.en: Unless these boundaries are enforced at the firmware or control-library level, tool developers should implement explicit validation and operational limits within the tool package.
sents.zh: 除非这些边界在固件或控制库层面得到强制执行，否则工具开发者应在工具包中实施明确的验证和运行限制。

sents.en: Agent actuation requires exclusive control authority and remains subject to immediate operator override.
sents.zh: 智能体的执行需要独占的控制权限，但仍可被操作员即时覆盖。

sents.en: The agent is further restricted by capability gating and command-rate limits, so only approved classes of commands may be issued.
sents.zh: 智能体还受到能力门控和命令速率限制的限制，因此只能发出经批准的命令类别。

paragraphs.en: Use high-level APIs for instrument control tools. Abstract low-level routines when designing instrument control APIs. Keep these routines within tool or software implementations instead of exposing them directly to the agent. This reduces the unpredictability and performance degradation associated with providing numerous low-level APIs, and the same principle applies to both tools and skills. For example, if the agent only needs to acquire images at specified locations, expose an acquire_image tool that accepts locations, scan steps, and other necessary parameters. Do not require the agent to move motors, control shutters, and collect detector data through a sequence of separate calls. Generic device-level access remains useful as a deliberate escape hatch for diagnosis and setup, but it should be presented as such: where an instrument already defines high-level plans, as a Bluesky Instrument Template Structure (BITS) instrument does. Plans are the intended agent-facing abstraction and per-signal reads and writes are the exception.
paragraphs.zh: 使用高级 API 来构建仪器控制工具。 在设计仪器控制 API 时，应对底层程序进行抽象处理。 将这些底层程序保留在工具或软件实现内部，而不是直接暴露给智能体。 这样可以减少提供大量底层 API 所带来的不可预测性和性能下降问题，而这一原则同样适用于工具和技能。 例如，如果智能体只需要在指定位置获取图像，就应提供一个 accept_locations、scan_steps 和其他必要参数的 acquire_image 工具。 不要要求智能体通过一系列独立的调用来移动电机、控制快门和收集探测器数据。 通用的设备级访问权限作为诊断和设置时的有意“逃生通道”仍然有用，但应明确以这种形式呈现：当仪器本身已定义了高级计划时，就像 Bluesky Instrument Template Structure (BITS) 仪器那样。 计划是面向智能体的预期抽象层，而每个信号的读写操作则是例外情况。

sents.en: Use high-level APIs for instrument control tools.
sents.zh: 使用高级 API 来构建仪器控制工具。

sents.en: Abstract low-level routines when designing instrument control APIs.
sents.zh: 在设计仪器控制 API 时，应对底层程序进行抽象处理。

sents.en: Keep these routines within tool or software implementations instead of exposing them directly to the agent.
sents.zh: 将这些底层程序保留在工具或软件实现内部，而不是直接暴露给智能体。

sents.en: This reduces the unpredictability and performance degradation associated with providing numerous low-level APIs, and the same principle applies to both tools and skills.
sents.zh: 这样可以减少提供大量底层 API 所带来的不可预测性和性能下降问题，而这一原则同样适用于工具和技能。

sents.en: For example, if the agent only needs to acquire images at specified locations, expose an acquire_image tool that accepts locations, scan steps, and other necessary parameters.
sents.zh: 例如，如果智能体只需要在指定位置获取图像，就应提供一个 accept_locations、scan_steps 和其他必要参数的 acquire_image 工具。

sents.en: Do not require the agent to move motors, control shutters, and collect detector data through a sequence of separate calls.
sents.zh: 不要要求智能体通过一系列独立的调用来移动电机、控制快门和收集探测器数据。

sents.en: Generic device-level access remains useful as a deliberate escape hatch for diagnosis and setup, but it should be presented as such: where an instrument already defines high-level plans, as a Bluesky Instrument Template Structure (BITS) instrument does.
sents.zh: 通用的设备级访问权限作为诊断和设置时的有意“逃生通道”仍然有用，但应明确以这种形式呈现：当仪器本身已定义了高级计划时，就像 Bluesky Instrument Template Structure (BITS) 仪器那样。

sents.en: Plans are the intended agent-facing abstraction and per-signal reads and writes are the exception.
sents.zh: 计划是面向智能体的预期抽象层，而每个信号的读写操作则是例外情况。

paragraphs.en: Handle non-text data explicitly. Some tools yield images or other high-dimensional data, such as microprobe datasets with X-ray fluorescence or X-ray diffraction information. When the inference interface expects textual tool results, as many OpenAI-compatible chat-completion interfaces do, a viable path to present tool-yielded images to the LLM should be implemented.
paragraphs.zh: 明确处理非文本数据。 某些工具会生成图像或其他高维数据，例如包含X射线荧光或X射线衍射信息的微探针数据集。 当推理接口期望工具返回文本结果时（许多兼容OpenAI的聊天补全接口都是如此），应实现一种可行的方法，将工具生成的图像呈现给大型语言模型。

sents.en: Handle non-text data explicitly.
sents.zh: 明确处理非文本数据。

sents.en: Some tools yield images or other high-dimensional data, such as microprobe datasets with X-ray fluorescence or X-ray diffraction information.
sents.zh: 某些工具会生成图像或其他高维数据，例如包含X射线荧光或X射线衍射信息的微探针数据集。

sents.en: When the inference interface expects textual tool results, as many OpenAI-compatible chat-completion interfaces do, a viable path to present tool-yielded images to the LLM should be implemented.
sents.zh: 当推理接口期望工具返回文本结果时（许多兼容OpenAI的聊天补全接口都是如此），应实现一种可行的方法，将工具生成的图像呈现给大型语言模型。

paragraphs.en: Make agent actions observable and reviewable. Every tool call, its arguments, and its return value should be logged in a structured form that can be later queried. For actions that may affect the data on the host computer systems, or those that change instrument states or otherwise cannot be undone, the harness should support a human-in-the-loop confirmation mode that requires the operator to approve the call before it executes. Observability and confirmability make agentic operation auditable and reproducible.
paragraphs.zh: 使智能体的行为可观察且可审查。 每次工具调用及其参数和返回值都应以结构化形式记录，以便后续查询。 对于可能影响主机计算机系统数据、改变设备状态或无法撤销的操作，执行框架应支持人工介入确认模式，要求操作员在执行前批准该调用。 可观察性和可确认性使智能体操作具备审计性和可重复性。

paragraphs.en: Treat learning as a governed lifecycle rather than as uncontrolled self-modification. Before an experiment, an agent may retrieve previous procedures and outcomes; during operation, it may adapt within approved bounds; after the experiment, it may propose memories or skill updates based on the decisions, corrections, failures, and outcomes that were recorded. Knowledge should flow in both directions: scientists teach procedures and exceptions, while agents return explanations, evidence, and reusable lessons. This process extends demonstrated approaches for retaining and reusing human feedback [ 3 ] . However, proposed updates should retain their provenance and become authoritative only after evaluation, expert review, versioning, and approval, with a defined path for rollback.
paragraphs.zh: 将学习视为一个受管理的生命周期，而非不受控制的自我修改。 在实验之前，智能体可以调取先前的流程与结果；在运行过程中，它可以在批准的范围内进行调整；实验结束后，它可以根据记录下来的决策、修正、失败和结果，提出记忆或技能更新建议。 知识应当双向流动：科学家教授流程和例外情况，而智能体则返回解释、证据和可复用的经验教训。 这一过程扩展了保留和复用人类反馈的已有方法 [ 3 ] 。 然而，拟议的更新应保留其来源信息，并且只有在经过评估、专家审查、版本控制和批准之后才能成为权威内容，同时需有明确的回滚路径。

paragraphs.en: These principles and the deployment requirements developed below map directly onto the architecture in Fig. 1 . The need for reachable and resilient endpoints leads to configurable inference services, while decoupling and reusability motivate the hub and its independently deployed tool servers. Concurrency and safety requirements lead to synchronous control workers, interlocks, and approval boundaries; high-level interfaces and explicit handling of non-text data lead to stable tool and data contracts. Finally, computational requirements motivate external analysis and inference services, while observability and governed learning require cross-cutting services for auditing, provenance, knowledge, and skill registries. The deployment practices below implement this mapping one component at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 这些原则以及下文提出的部署要求可以直接对应到图 1 中的架构。 对可访问且具备弹性的端点的需求催生了可配置的推理服务，而解耦和可重用性则推动了中心枢纽及其独立部署的工具服务器的设计。 并发性和安全性要求促成了同步控制工作者、互锁机制和审批边界；高层接口以及对非文本数据的显式处理则带来了稳定的工具和数据契约。 最后，计算需求推动了外部分析和推理服务的发展，而可观察性和受控学习则需要贯穿系统的服务来支持审计、来源追溯、知识管理和技能注册表。 下文的部署实践将逐步实现这一架构映射，一次完成一个组件。

paragraphs.en: The design principles in Section 2 are deliberately harness-agnostic. They apply whether the harness is EAA [ 4 ] , Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes Agent, VISION [ 5 ] , or a custom Python application.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节中的设计原则是有意做到与工具无关的。 无论使用的工具是 EAA [ 4 ]、Claude Code、OpenCode、Hermes Agent、VISION [ 5 ]，还是自定义的 Python 应用程序，这些原则都同样适用。

paragraphs.en: If images are not part of the workflow, use a standard agentic harness such as Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, Advanced Photon EXperiment Assistant (APEXA) , or OpenCode.
paragraphs.zh: 如果图像不是工作流程的一部分，请使用标准的智能体框架，例如 Hermes Agent、Claude Code、Codex、Advanced Photon EXperiment Assistant (APEXA) 或 OpenCode。

paragraphs.en: Use EAA as a starting harness for APS beamline control deployments that require image comprehension and display, as discussed below.
paragraphs.zh: 如下文所述，对于需要图像理解和显示的 APS 光束线控制部署，请将 EAA 用作初始框架。

paragraphs.en: Use PEAR if the focus is purely on ptychography analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 如果重点完全放在叠层成像分析上，请使用 PEAR。

paragraphs.en: Use APEXA if the focus is purely on HEDM analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 如果重点完全放在 HEDM 分析上，请使用 APEXA。

paragraphs.zh: 使用 Dr. XAS 进行 X 射线吸收光谱分析。

sents.zh: XAS 进行 X 射线吸收光谱分析。

paragraphs.en: If more specialized functionality or interface features are needed, first consider whether an extensible, open-source harness can provide the required core capabilities; otherwise, build a custom harness tailored to the beamline’s instrument-control and analysis requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 如果需要更专业的功能或界面特性，首先应考虑是否有一个可扩展的开源框架能够提供所需的核心能力；否则，应构建一个针对光束线仪器控制和分析需求的定制框架。

paragraphs.en: For beamline control, try EAA first because it already implements the features that the rest of this paper assumes: vision-language reasoning over instrument-generated imagery, two-way MCP compatibility (it can consume tools from external MCP servers and expose its own tools as an MCP service), hybrid autonomy that spans fully agent-driven workflows to deterministic logic with embedded LLM queries, and optional persistent memory across sessions. Beamlines that adopt EAA inherit the system layout described in Section 4.1.1 with little additional integration work. They can then extend EAA as needed or use it as a reference for a custom implementation. Persistent session memory provides continuity between interactions, but it does not by itself constitute lifecycle learning. Before information is promoted into shared facility knowledge, it should pass through the provenance, evaluation, and review process defined above.
paragraphs.zh: 对于光束线控制，请先尝试 EAA，因为它已经实现了本文其余部分所假设的功能：对仪器生成的图像进行视觉-语言推理、双向 MCP 兼容性（它可以使用外部 MCP 服务器的工具，并将其自身工具作为 MCP 服务暴露出来）、覆盖从完全由智能体驱动的工作流到包含嵌入式 LLM 查询的确定性逻辑的混合自主性，以及跨会话的可选持久化内存。 采用 EAA 的光束线可以继承第 4.1.1 节中描述的系统布局，而无需进行大量额外的集成工作。 然后，它们可以根据需要扩展 EAA，或将其作为自定义实现的参考。 持久的会话记忆可以在交互之间提供连续性，但它本身并不构成生命周期学习。 在信息被提升为共享设施知识之前，它应经过上述定义的来源、评估和审查流程。

paragraphs.en: We treat EAA as a starting step rather than a requirement. Claude Code is well-suited to rapid prototyping and workflows in which agent-authored code is the deliverable. A purpose-built harness may be warranted for instruments with unusual safety constraints or hard real-time requirements. As long as the chosen harness honors the principles in Section 2 , the practices that follow in Sections 3.1.2 through 3.2.4 apply unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 EAA 视为一个初始步骤，而非一项要求。 Claude Code 非常适合快速原型开发以及以智能体编写的代码为交付成果的工作流程。 对于具有特殊安全限制或硬实时要求的设备，可能需要使用专门设计的测试框架。 只要所选的测试框架遵循第 2 节中的原则，第 3.1.2 节至第 3.2.4 节中后续的实践方法将保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Before implementing a new harness, teams should consider whether a community-developed harness can provide a maintained core that they extend for local requirements. Pi is one concrete option: its MIT-licensed repository separates the model API, agent runtime, coding-agent interface, terminal UI, and WebUI components into reusable packages. Its agent and coding-agent layers already support persistent session trees, image content in user and tool-result messages, and configurable serial or parallel tool execution [ 8 , 9 ] . These shared mechanisms do not by themselves guarantee reliable beamline operation, which still requires local testing and the safeguards described in this paper. However, they can reduce the amount of facility-specific infrastructure that must be implemented and maintained. Because Pi’s development, examples, and issue tracker are public, while extensions can be distributed as npm or Git packages, local additions can also be reviewed and reused outside the original deployment [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在实施新的框架之前，团队应考虑社区开发的框架是否能提供一个持续维护的核心模块，供其根据本地需求进行扩展。 Pi 是一个具体的选择：其采用 MIT 许可的仓库将模型 API、智能体运行时、编码智能体接口、终端用户界面和 WebUI 组件拆分为可重用的包。 其智能体和编码智能体层已支持持久化的会话树、用户消息和工具结果消息中的图像内容，以及可配置的串行或并行工具执行 [ 8 , 9 ] 。 这些共享机制本身并不能保证光束线的可靠运行，这仍然需要本地测试以及本文所述的安全保障措施。 然而，它们可以减少必须实施和维护的特定设施基础设施的数量。 由于 Pi 的开发、示例和问题跟踪器都是公开的，而扩展可以以 npm 或 Git 包的形式分发，因此本地添加的内容也可以在原始部署之外被审查和重用 [ 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Pi provides two documented integration paths that permit such additions without maintaining a fork. A Node.js application can embed an agent session through the Pi software development kit, whereas a language-independent application can run Pi in remote procedure call (RPC) mode and exchange newline-delimited JSON commands and events with the process. The RPC protocol also carries extension-generated dialog requests and client responses, allowing a custom WebUI backend to present confirmations or input dialogs and to relay user responses while Pi retains the agent loop and session state [ 10 ] . Multi-agent behavior can likewise be added as an extension rather than a core modification. For example, Pi’s official subagent extension launches separate Pi processes and supports single, parallel, and chained execution, with the output of one agent passed to the next; a generator-to-reviewer sequence can therefore be assembled from the documented chain mechanism [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Pi 提供了两种经过文档验证的集成路径，无需维护分支即可实现此类扩展。 Node.js 应用程序可以通过 Pi 软件开发工具包嵌入智能体会话，而一种与语言无关的应用程序则可以在远程过程调用（RPC）模式下运行 Pi，并与进程交换以换行符分隔的 JSON 命令和事件。 RPC 协议还传输由扩展生成的对话请求和客户端响应，这使得自定义 WebUI 后端能够显示确认信息或输入对话框，并传递用户响应，同时 Pi 仍保持智能体循环和会话状态 [ 10 ] 。 多智能体行为同样可以作为扩展添加，而非作为核心修改。 例如，Pi 的官方子智能体扩展会启动独立的 Pi 进程，并支持单线程、并行和链式执行，其中一个智能体的输出会被传递给下一个；因此，可以通过文档中描述的链式机制构建从生成器到评审员的序列 [ 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: This extensibility introduces practical limitations. Pi extensions are TypeScript modules, which creates an additional implementation and maintenance burden for teams whose software stack is primarily Python. Extensions and installable packages also execute with the user’s system permissions, so third-party code must be reviewed and constrained before it is connected to instrument-control tools [ 10 ] . Moreover, Pi deliberately leaves Model Context Protocol integration, subagents, and background shell execution outside its core [ 8 ] . The extension example demonstrates that subagents are possible, but conditional or cyclic multi-agent workflows require custom orchestration; in contrast, LangGraph directly represents shared state, nodes, branches, loops, and parallel execution, and documents evaluator–optimizer and orchestrator–worker patterns [ 12 ] . Similarly, Pi does not document a built-in mechanism that releases a running tool with a queryable session identifier. Such non-blocking execution would need to be supplied by an external job service or by a custom submit-and-poll tool contract. Teams should weigh these integration costs against the benefit of reusing a shared agent runtime before selecting Pi or developing a purpose-built harness.
paragraphs.zh: 这种可扩展性带来了实际的限制。 Pi 扩展是 TypeScript 模块，这为主要使用 Python 软件栈的团队增加了额外的实现和维护负担。 扩展和可安装包也会以用户的系统权限运行，因此第三方代码在连接到仪器控制工具之前必须经过审查和限制 [ 10 ] 。 此外，Pi 有意将模型上下文协议集成、子智能体和后台 shell 执行排除在其核心功能之外 [ 8 ] 。 扩展示例表明子智能体是可行的，但条件性或循环的多智能体工作流程需要自定义编排；相比之下，LangGraph 直接表示共享状态、节点、分支、循环和并行执行，并记录了评估器–优化器和协调器–工作者模式 [ 12 ] 。 同样，Pi 并未记录任何内置机制来通过可查询的会话标识符释放正在运行的工具。 这种非阻塞的执行需要由外部作业服务或自定义的提交与轮询工具合同来实现。 团队在选择 Pi 或开发专用运行时之前，应权衡这些集成成本与复用共享智能体运行时的收益。

sents.en: This extensibility introduces practical limitations.
sents.zh: 这种可扩展性带来了实际的限制。

sents.en: Pi extensions are TypeScript modules, which creates an additional implementation and maintenance burden for teams whose software stack is primarily Python.
sents.zh: Pi 扩展是 TypeScript 模块，这为主要使用 Python 软件栈的团队增加了额外的实现和维护负担。

sents.en: Extensions and installable packages also execute with the user’s system permissions, so third-party code must be reviewed and constrained before it is connected to instrument-control tools [ 10 ] .
sents.zh: 扩展和可安装包也会以用户的系统权限运行，因此第三方代码在连接到仪器控制工具之前必须经过审查和限制 [ 10 ] 。

sents.en: Moreover, Pi deliberately leaves Model Context Protocol integration, subagents, and background shell execution outside its core [ 8 ] .
sents.zh: 此外，Pi 有意将模型上下文协议集成、子智能体和后台 shell 执行排除在其核心功能之外 [ 8 ] 。

sents.en: The extension example demonstrates that subagents are possible, but conditional or cyclic multi-agent workflows require custom orchestration; in contrast, LangGraph directly represents shared state, nodes, branches, loops, and parallel execution, and documents evaluator–optimizer and orchestrator–worker patterns [ 12 ] .
sents.zh: 扩展示例表明子智能体是可行的，但条件性或循环的多智能体工作流程需要自定义编排；相比之下，LangGraph 直接表示共享状态、节点、分支、循环和并行执行，并记录了评估器–优化器和协调器–工作者模式 [ 12 ] 。

sents.en: Similarly, Pi does not document a built-in mechanism that releases a running tool with a queryable session identifier.
sents.zh: 同样，Pi 并未记录任何内置机制来通过可查询的会话标识符释放正在运行的工具。

sents.en: Such non-blocking execution would need to be supplied by an external job service or by a custom submit-and-poll tool contract.
sents.zh: 这种非阻塞的执行需要由外部作业服务或自定义的提交与轮询工具合同来实现。

sents.en: Teams should weigh these integration costs against the benefit of reusing a shared agent runtime before selecting Pi or developing a purpose-built harness.
sents.zh: 团队在选择 Pi 或开发专用运行时之前，应权衡这些集成成本与复用共享智能体运行时的收益。

paragraphs.en: Two practical issues are worth flagging at deployment time. First, the harness can assume an API format ( e.g. , the OpenAI Chat Completions API), but should be provider-agnostic and, if possible, model-agnostic. Endpoint URLs, model names, and authentication keys should therefore be configurable. Hard-coding configuration values, especially API keys, should be avoided even when the harness runs under a service account.
paragraphs.zh: 在部署时，有两个实际问题值得指出。 首先，该工具可以假定某种 API 格式（例如 OpenAI Chat Completions API），但应当与具体提供商无关，并且如果可能的话，也应与具体模型无关。 因此，端点 URL、模型名称和认证密钥都应当可配置。 即使该工具在服务账户下运行，也应避免硬编码配置值，尤其是 API 密钥。

sents.en: Two practical issues are worth flagging at deployment time.
sents.zh: 在部署时，有两个实际问题值得指出。

sents.en: First, the harness can assume an API format ( e.g. , the OpenAI Chat Completions API), but should be provider-agnostic and, if possible, model-agnostic.
sents.zh: 首先，该工具可以假定某种 API 格式（例如 OpenAI Chat Completions API），但应当与具体提供商无关，并且如果可能的话，也应与具体模型无关。

sents.en: Endpoint URLs, model names, and authentication keys should therefore be configurable.
sents.zh: 因此，端点 URL、模型名称和认证密钥都应当可配置。

sents.en: Hard-coding configuration values, especially API keys, should be avoided even when the harness runs under a service account.
sents.zh: 即使该工具在服务账户下运行，也应避免硬编码配置值，尤其是 API 密钥。

paragraphs.en: Second, the agent harness should have retry mechanisms that reattempts queries when the initial query fails due to rate limit or temporary server hangs. A primary/fallback mechanism, where the harness attempts the preferred endpoint (for example, Argo) and transparently falls back to an OpenAI-compatible local model when the primary endpoint is unreachable, can be considered, but the switch to the fallback path should be made transparent to the user, or require human approval.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，智能体工具包应具备重试机制，在初始查询因速率限制或服务器暂时挂起而失败时，能够重新尝试执行查询。 可以考虑采用主/备用机制：工具包首先尝试首选端点（例如 Argo），当主端点无法访问时，则透明地切换到兼容 OpenAI 的本地模型；但切换到备用路径的操作应对用户保持透明，或需要人工批准。

sents.en: Second, the agent harness should have retry mechanisms that reattempts queries when the initial query fails due to rate limit or temporary server hangs.
sents.zh: 其次，智能体工具包应具备重试机制，在初始查询因速率限制或服务器暂时挂起而失败时，能够重新尝试执行查询。

sents.en: A primary/fallback mechanism, where the harness attempts the preferred endpoint (for example, Argo) and transparently falls back to an OpenAI-compatible local model when the primary endpoint is unreachable, can be considered, but the switch to the fallback path should be made transparent to the user, or require human approval.
sents.zh: 可以考虑采用主/备用机制：工具包首先尝试首选端点（例如 Argo），当主端点无法访问时，则透明地切换到兼容 OpenAI 的本地模型；但切换到备用路径的操作应对用户保持透明，或需要人工批准。

paragraphs.en: When the LLM provider expects textual tool messages, as in many OpenAI-compatible chat-completion interfaces, the harness must process images and other non-serializable data separately. Even with APIs that support richer multimodal content, harness-side design is still required if the agent needs to access raw numerical data ( e.g. , NumPy arrays). This section introduces recommended strategies for image viewing and numerical data access.
paragraphs.zh: 当 LLM 提供商期望接收文本形式的工具消息时（如许多兼容 OpenAI 的聊天补全接口），执行框架必须单独处理图像和其他无法序列化的数据。 即使使用支持更丰富多模态内容的 API，如果智能体需要访问原始数值数据（例如 NumPy 数组），仍然需要在执行框架侧进行设计。 本节将介绍图像查看和数值数据访问的推荐策略。

sents.en: When the LLM provider expects textual tool messages, as in many OpenAI-compatible chat-completion interfaces, the harness must process images and other non-serializable data separately.
sents.zh: 当 LLM 提供商期望接收文本形式的工具消息时（如许多兼容 OpenAI 的聊天补全接口），执行框架必须单独处理图像和其他无法序列化的数据。

sents.en: Even with APIs that support richer multimodal content, harness-side design is still required if the agent needs to access raw numerical data ( e.g. , NumPy arrays).
sents.zh: 即使使用支持更丰富多模态内容的 API，如果智能体需要访问原始数值数据（例如 NumPy 数组），仍然需要在执行框架侧进行设计。

sents.en: This section introduces recommended strategies for image viewing and numerical data access.
sents.zh: 本节将介绍图像查看和数值数据访问的推荐策略。

paragraphs.en: If the goal is to let the agent “see” tool-generated images without performing numerical analysis, two approaches are available:
paragraphs.zh: 如果目标是让智能体“看到”工具生成的图像而无需进行数值分析，有两种方法可供选择：

paragraphs.en: Let the tool render the image as a PNG file, save it to disk, and return its absolute path. The harness loads the image, encodes it in base64, creates a user or system message with the encoded image, and injects the message into the context. This approach requires the tool server and harness to run on the same computer or use shared storage mounted at the same absolute path. The harness and tool must follow a contract that enables the harness to identify the image path. We recommend returning a JSON object with an img_path field like the following:
paragraphs.zh: 让该工具将图像渲染为 PNG 文件，将其保存到磁盘，并返回其绝对路径。 该框架加载图像，将其编码为 base64，使用编码后的图像创建一个用户消息或系统消息，并将该消息注入上下文。 这种方法要求工具服务器和框架运行在同一台计算机上，或使用挂载在相同绝对路径上的共享存储。 框架和工具必须遵循一项协议，以便框架能够识别图像路径。 我们建议返回一个包含 img_path 字段的 JSON 对象，如下所示：

sents.en: Let the tool render the image as a PNG file, save it to disk, and return its absolute path.
sents.zh: 让该工具将图像渲染为 PNG 文件，将其保存到磁盘，并返回其绝对路径。

sents.en: The harness loads the image, encodes it in base64, creates a user or system message with the encoded image, and injects the message into the context.
sents.zh: 该框架加载图像，将其编码为 base64，使用编码后的图像创建一个用户消息或系统消息，并将该消息注入上下文。

sents.en: This approach requires the tool server and harness to run on the same computer or use shared storage mounted at the same absolute path.
sents.zh: 这种方法要求工具服务器和框架运行在同一台计算机上，或使用挂载在相同绝对路径上的共享存储。

sents.en: The harness and tool must follow a contract that enables the harness to identify the image path.
sents.zh: 框架和工具必须遵循一项协议，以便框架能够识别图像路径。

sents.en: We recommend returning a JSON object with an img_path field like the following:
sents.zh: 我们建议返回一个包含 img_path 字段的 JSON 对象，如下所示：

paragraphs.en: The harness should parse the JSON object and handle images when this field is non-empty.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架应解析 JSON 对象，并在此字段非空时处理图像。

paragraphs.en: Let the tool encode the image in base64 and transmit the encoded data directly. The harness moves the encoded data out of the tool response and into a follow-up user or system message. This approach does not require the tool server and harness to access the same storage, but it becomes much more important to ensure the harness can handle it properly when using the Completions API – in that case, the harness should intercept the tool return, extract and remove the encoded data from the tool response message, then synthesize a user message with the encoded image. If the harness blindly forwards whatever the tool returns to the inference endpoint that uses the Completions API, the image will not be understood and the base64 encoding could consume a large number of tokens. Modern APIs like the Responses API can receive encoded images directly contained in tool responses, but fallback mechanisms should still be implemented if the Responses API is not guaranteed.
paragraphs.zh: 让工具将图像编码为 base64，并直接传输编码后的数据。 框架会将编码后的数据从工具响应中提取出来，并放入后续的用户或系统消息中。 这种方法不需要工具服务器和框架访问相同的存储，但在使用 Completions API 时，确保框架能正确处理这些数据就变得更加重要——在这种情况下，框架应拦截工具的返回值，从工具响应消息中提取并移除编码后的数据，然后合成一个包含编码图像的用戶消息。 如果框架将工具返回的任何内容都直接转发给使用 Completions API 的推理端点，那么图像将无法被识别，且 base64 编码可能会消耗大量 token。 像 Responses API 这样的现代 API 可以直接接收包含在工具响应中的编码图像，但如果无法保证使用 Responses API，仍然应实现备用机制。

sents.en: Let the tool encode the image in base64 and transmit the encoded data directly.
sents.zh: 让工具将图像编码为 base64，并直接传输编码后的数据。

sents.en: The harness moves the encoded data out of the tool response and into a follow-up user or system message.
sents.zh: 框架会将编码后的数据从工具响应中提取出来，并放入后续的用户或系统消息中。

sents.en: This approach does not require the tool server and harness to access the same storage, but it becomes much more important to ensure the harness can handle it properly when using the Completions API – in that case, the harness should intercept the tool return, extract and remove the encoded data from the tool response message, then synthesize a user message with the encoded image.
sents.zh: 这种方法不需要工具服务器和框架访问相同的存储，但在使用 Completions API 时，确保框架能正确处理这些数据就变得更加重要——在这种情况下，框架应拦截工具的返回值，从工具响应消息中提取并移除编码后的数据，然后合成一个包含编码图像的用戶消息。

sents.en: If the harness blindly forwards whatever the tool returns to the inference endpoint that uses the Completions API, the image will not be understood and the base64 encoding could consume a large number of tokens.
sents.zh: 如果框架将工具返回的任何内容都直接转发给使用 Completions API 的推理端点，那么图像将无法被识别，且 base64 编码可能会消耗大量 token。

sents.en: Modern APIs like the Responses API can receive encoded images directly contained in tool responses, but fallback mechanisms should still be implemented if the Responses API is not guaranteed.
sents.zh: 像 Responses API 这样的现代 API 可以直接接收包含在工具响应中的编码图像，但如果无法保证使用 Responses API，仍然应实现备用机制。

paragraphs.en: Caution : The harness and tool must follow a contract that enables the harness to identify the encoded image data, intercept it, and send it to the LLM in a conforming format so that the LLM inference provider recognizes the image. Directly sending the encoding to the LLM as text should be strictly avoided: LLMs won’t “see” base64 encoding as images, and the near-random characters in a base64 encoding uses a very large amount of tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：约束器和工具必须遵循一项协议，使约束器能够识别编码后的图像数据、拦截该数据，并以符合要求的格式将其发送给 LLM，以便 LLM 推理提供商能够识别该图像。 严禁将编码直接以文本形式发送给 LLM：LLM 不会将 base64 编码视为图像，且 base64 编码中近乎随机的字符会消耗大量 token。

sents.en: Caution : The harness and tool must follow a contract that enables the harness to identify the encoded image data, intercept it, and send it to the LLM in a conforming format so that the LLM inference provider recognizes the image.
sents.zh: 注意：约束器和工具必须遵循一项协议，使约束器能够识别编码后的图像数据、拦截该数据，并以符合要求的格式将其发送给 LLM，以便 LLM 推理提供商能够识别该图像。

sents.en: Directly sending the encoding to the LLM as text should be strictly avoided: LLMs won’t “see” base64 encoding as images, and the near-random characters in a base64 encoding uses a very large amount of tokens.
sents.zh: 严禁将编码直接以文本形式发送给 LLM：LLM 不会将 base64 编码视为图像，且 base64 编码中近乎随机的字符会消耗大量 token。

paragraphs.en: For either case, if the data acquisition logic called by the tool always saves images to disk in a non-image format (for example, an HDF5), the tool should extract the image, render it as PNG, and return. Directly returning the path to the non-image data file and expecting the agent to load and render the image is also possible, but not recommended as it requires additional data extraction and image rendering by the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 在这两种情况下，如果工具调用的数据获取逻辑始终将图像以非图像格式（例如 HDF5）保存到磁盘，则工具应提取图像、将其渲染为 PNG 并返回。 直接返回非图像数据文件的路径，并期望智能体加载和渲染图像也是可行的，但不推荐这样做，因为这需要智能体执行额外的数据提取和图像渲染操作。

sents.en: For either case, if the data acquisition logic called by the tool always saves images to disk in a non-image format (for example, an HDF5), the tool should extract the image, render it as PNG, and return.
sents.zh: 在这两种情况下，如果工具调用的数据获取逻辑始终将图像以非图像格式（例如 HDF5）保存到磁盘，则工具应提取图像、将其渲染为 PNG 并返回。

sents.en: Directly returning the path to the non-image data file and expecting the agent to load and render the image is also possible, but not recommended as it requires additional data extraction and image rendering by the agent.
sents.zh: 直接返回非图像数据文件的路径，并期望智能体加载和渲染图像也是可行的，但不推荐这样做，因为这需要智能体执行额外的数据提取和图像渲染操作。

paragraphs.en: If the goal is to let the agent perform numerical analysis of images or arrays, the data should be saved to disk and the agent should be given the path to the file. The agent can then write analysis code that loads the data. We consider two scenarios here:
paragraphs.zh: 如果目标是让智能体对图像或数组进行数值分析，则应将数据保存到磁盘，并将文件路径提供给该智能体。 然后，智能体可以编写用于加载数据的分析代码。 我们在此考虑两种情况：

sents.en: If the goal is to let the agent perform numerical analysis of images or arrays, the data should be saved to disk and the agent should be given the path to the file.
sents.zh: 如果目标是让智能体对图像或数组进行数值分析，则应将数据保存到磁盘，并将文件路径提供给该智能体。

sents.en: The agent can then write analysis code that loads the data.
sents.zh: 然后，智能体可以编写用于加载数据的分析代码。

sents.en: We consider two scenarios here:
sents.zh: 我们在此考虑两种情况：

paragraphs.en: Scenario 1: the data acquisition backend already saves data to a structured format, such as HDF5
paragraphs.zh: 场景 1：数据获取后端已将数据保存为结构化格式，例如 HDF5

paragraphs.en: In this case, let the tool return the path to the data file and expect the agent to load and/or decode data from that file when writing analysis code. However, if the data structure of the file is complicated, the agent should know how and where ( e.g. , the path to the dataset in an HDF5 file) to find and load the data. We recommend embedding the file paths and dataset paths in the returned payload. For example:
paragraphs.zh: 在这种情况下，让工具返回数据文件的路径，并期望智能体在编写分析代码时从该文件中加载和/或解码数据。 然而，如果文件的数据结构复杂，智能体应知道如何以及在哪里（例如，HDF5 文件中数据集的路径）查找和加载数据。 我们建议将文件路径和数据集路径嵌入到返回的有效负载中。例如：

sents.en: In this case, let the tool return the path to the data file and expect the agent to load and/or decode data from that file when writing analysis code.
sents.zh: 在这种情况下，让工具返回数据文件的路径，并期望智能体在编写分析代码时从该文件中加载和/或解码数据。

sents.en: However, if the data structure of the file is complicated, the agent should know how and where ( e.g. , the path to the dataset in an HDF5 file) to find and load the data.
sents.zh: 然而，如果文件的数据结构复杂，智能体应知道如何以及在哪里（例如，HDF5 文件中数据集的路径）查找和加载数据。

sents.en: We recommend embedding the file paths and dataset paths in the returned payload. For example:
sents.zh: 我们建议将文件路径和数据集路径嵌入到返回的有效负载中。例如：

paragraphs.en: Alternatively, after the backend logic saves the data to disk, load the data to memory in the tool, save only the relevant array as an NPY file. This requires an additional processing step in the tool logic but reduces the tool calls and context usage by the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 或者，在后台逻辑将数据保存到磁盘后，可以在工具中将数据加载到内存中，然后仅将相关数组保存为 NPY 文件。 这需要在工具逻辑中添加一个额外的处理步骤，但可以减少智能体的工具调用和上下文使用量。

sents.en: Alternatively, after the backend logic saves the data to disk, load the data to memory in the tool, save only the relevant array as an NPY file.
sents.zh: 或者，在后台逻辑将数据保存到磁盘后，可以在工具中将数据加载到内存中，然后仅将相关数组保存为 NPY 文件。

sents.en: This requires an additional processing step in the tool logic but reduces the tool calls and context usage by the agent.
sents.zh: 这需要在工具逻辑中添加一个额外的处理步骤，但可以减少智能体的工具调用和上下文使用量。

paragraphs.en: Scenario 2: the yielded data is small and the backend logic does not save it to disk by default
paragraphs.zh: 场景 2：生成的数据量很小，且后端逻辑默认不会将其保存到磁盘

paragraphs.en: If the relevant data is only one or a few arrays and live in memory (e.g., data streamed back from the detector), they may be transmitted through either file storage or direct encoding:
paragraphs.zh: 如果相关数据仅包含一个或少数几个数组，并且存在于内存中（例如，从探测器流式传输回来的数据），则可以通过文件存储或直接编码进行传输：

paragraphs.en: Let the tool server save the array as an NPY file in storage shared with the harness process, then return the path and other metadata. We recommend a JSON object such as:

paragraphs.en: Tools that perform data acquisition or complicated analyses may take minutes or even hours to finish. In a single-threaded, synchronous agentic harness, such a tool blocks the agent loop and prevents the agent from responding to the user or performing other tasks until the execution finishes. Allowing selected tool executions to continue in the background can therefore substantially improve the user experience.
paragraphs.zh: 执行数据获取或复杂分析的工具可能需要几分钟甚至几个小时才能完成。 在单线程、同步的智能体框架中，这类工具会阻塞智能体循环，导致智能体无法响应用户或执行其他任务，直到执行完成为止。 因此，允许选定的工具执行在后台继续运行，可以显著提升用户体验。

sents.en: Tools that perform data acquisition or complicated analyses may take minutes or even hours to finish.
sents.zh: 执行数据获取或复杂分析的工具可能需要几分钟甚至几个小时才能完成。

sents.en: In a single-threaded, synchronous agentic harness, such a tool blocks the agent loop and prevents the agent from responding to the user or performing other tasks until the execution finishes.

sents.en: Allowing selected tool executions to continue in the background can therefore substantially improve the user experience.
sents.zh: 因此，允许选定的工具执行在后台继续运行，可以显著提升用户体验。

paragraphs.en: A harness can provide non-blocking execution without requiring tool implementations to adopt an additional asynchronous submission-and-polling contract. One approach is to add an opt-in release timeout and run eligible calls in daemon worker threads. The graph-owning thread waits for the configured timeout after starting a worker. If the call finishes within that interval, the harness returns its result as an ordinary tool response. If the timeout expires, the harness instead returns an interim tool response indicating that execution is still underway, while the worker continues running in the background:
paragraphs.zh: 执行框架可以在无需工具实现采用额外的异步提交与轮询协议的情况下，提供非阻塞执行。 一种方法是为可选参与机制添加释放超时设置，并在守护工作线程中运行符合条件的调用。 图的所有者线程在启动一个工作线程后，会等待配置好的超时时间。 如果调用在该时间间隔内完成，执行框架将将其结果作为普通工具响应返回。 如果超时结束，执行框架则会返回一个临时工具响应，表明执行仍在进行中，而工作线程则继续在后台运行：

sents.en: A harness can provide non-blocking execution without requiring tool implementations to adopt an additional asynchronous submission-and-polling contract.
sents.zh: 执行框架可以在无需工具实现采用额外的异步提交与轮询协议的情况下，提供非阻塞执行。

sents.en: One approach is to add an opt-in release timeout and run eligible calls in daemon worker threads.
sents.zh: 一种方法是为可选参与机制添加释放超时设置，并在守护工作线程中运行符合条件的调用。

sents.zh: 图的所有者线程在启动一个工作线程后，会等待配置好的超时时间。

sents.en: If the call finishes within that interval, the harness returns its result as an ordinary tool response.
sents.zh: 如果调用在该时间间隔内完成，执行框架将将其结果作为普通工具响应返回。

sents.en: If the timeout expires, the harness instead returns an interim tool response indicating that execution is still underway, while the worker continues running in the background:
sents.zh: 如果超时结束，执行框架则会返回一个临时工具响应，表明执行仍在进行中，而工作线程则继续在后台运行：

paragraphs.en: This interim message satisfies the call-response pairing required by the Chat Completions API. It also explicitly tells the model that the submitted work is still running and that the final result will arrive later. Once this message has been added to the context, the agent loop can continue, allowing the model to respond to the user and initiate other work.
paragraphs.zh: 这条临时消息满足了 Chat Completions API 所要求的请求-响应配对。 它还明确告知模型，提交的工作仍在运行中，最终结果稍后会到达。 一旦这条消息被添加到上下文中，智能体循环就可以继续，使模型能够响应用户并启动其他工作。

paragraphs.en: When a released execution finishes, the worker normalizes the result, places a completion record in a run-scoped queue, and signals the main thread. The main thread drains that queue and appends a harness-defined system message containing the completed result. This later system message is not a second protocol-level tool response for the original call; that call was already paired with the interim tool response. The completion signal can also wake the agent while it is waiting for user input, allowing the completed result to be delivered promptly.
paragraphs.zh: 当一次已释放的执行完成时，工作者会规范化结果，将一条完成记录放入运行作用域队列中，并向主线程发出信号。 主线程会处理该队列，并追加一条由测试框架定义的系统消息，其中包含已完成的结果。 这条后续的系统消息并非原始调用第二次出现的协议级工具响应；该调用早已与临时的工具响应配对。 完成信号也可以在智能体等待用户输入时将其唤醒，从而及时传递已完成的结果。

sents.en: When a released execution finishes, the worker normalizes the result, places a completion record in a run-scoped queue, and signals the main thread.
sents.zh: 当一次已释放的执行完成时，工作者会规范化结果，将一条完成记录放入运行作用域队列中，并向主线程发出信号。

sents.zh: 主线程会处理该队列，并追加一条由测试框架定义的系统消息，其中包含已完成的结果。

sents.zh: 这条后续的系统消息并非原始调用第二次出现的协议级工具响应；该调用早已与临时的工具响应配对。

sents.en: The completion signal can also wake the agent while it is waiting for user input, allowing the completed result to be delivered promptly.
sents.zh: 完成信号也可以在智能体等待用户输入时将其唤醒，从而及时传递已完成的结果。

paragraphs.en: Multiple released tool executions may run concurrently. Each execution should therefore receive a harness-generated job ID, and that ID should appear in both the interim tool response and the later completion message. The original tool call ID remains necessary for pairing the interim response with the assistant’s tool call, but a harness-owned job ID is preferable for correlating the later, out-of-band completion because it is stable, explicitly model-visible, and independent of provider-specific tool-call ID generation.
paragraphs.zh: 多个已释放的工具执行可能并发运行。 因此，每次执行都应获得一个由测试框架生成的作业 ID，且该 ID 应同时出现在临时工具响应和后续的完成消息中。 原始工具调用 ID 仍然有必要，用于将临时响应与智能体的工具调用匹配；但使用测试框架拥有的作业 ID 来关联后续的非同步完成消息更为理想，因为该 ID 稳定、模型能明确感知，且独立于提供商特定的工具调用 ID 生成机制。

sents.zh: 多个已释放的工具执行可能并发运行。

sents.zh: 因此，每次执行都应获得一个由测试框架生成的作业 ID，且该 ID 应同时出现在临时工具响应和后续的完成消息中。

sents.zh: 原始工具调用 ID 仍然有必要，用于将临时响应与智能体的工具调用匹配；但使用测试框架拥有的作业 ID 来关联后续的非同步完成消息更为理想，因为该 ID 稳定、模型能明确感知，且独立于提供商特定的工具调用 ID 生成机制。

paragraphs.en: The harness should scope completion delivery to the graph run that initiated the work, so that late results are not injected into an unrelated conversation. However, operations with persistent consequences require execution records independent of that graph run. Suppressing a stale notification must not delete the accepted request, operation identity, cancellation state, or eventual outcome. The in-process mechanism above does not by itself provide recovery after process failure; such recovery requires a durable execution service or equivalent persisted state. After interruption or an ambiguous response, the harness or orchestrator should reconcile with that service before resubmitting work, because an unanswered request does not establish that the operation was never accepted. A cancellation request should likewise not be reported as completed cancellation without confirmation. Memory summaries may reference these records but must not replace them; Section 3.6 extends this distinction to cross-service workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 执行框架应将完成交付的范围限定在启动该任务的图运行中，以免将延迟的结果注入到无关的对话中。 然而，具有持久影响的操作需要独立于该图运行的执行记录。 抑制过时的通知不得删除已接受请求、操作标识、取消状态或最终结果。 上述进程中的机制本身无法在进程故障后提供恢复；此类恢复需要持久的执行服务或等效的持久化状态。 在中断或响应不明确后，执行框架或协调器在重新提交任务前应与该服务进行协调，因为未响应的请求并不能证明该操作从未被接受。 同样，取消请求未经确认也不应被报告为已完成取消。 内存摘要可以引用这些记录，但不得替代它们；第 3.6 节将这一区别扩展到跨服务的工作流中。

paragraphs.en: An alternative is to split a long operation into a submission tool and a status query tool. The agent first calls the submission tool, which returns immediately while execution continues on a server, and later calls the status tool to obtain progress or the final result. However, this approach requires dedicated tool-side design, forces the agent to make additional tool calls, and raises the question of when and how often status should be queried. When existing synchronous tools must be supported without such changes, keeping the release and completion mechanism in the harness is generally simpler.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种方法是将一个长操作拆分为一个提交工具和状态查询工具。 智能体首先调用提交工具，该工具会立即返回，而执行则在服务器上继续；之后，智能体再调用状态工具以获取进度或最终结果。 然而，这种方法需要专门针对工具端进行设计，迫使智能体进行额外的工具调用，并引发了关于何时以及应多频繁地查询状态的疑问。 当必须在不进行此类更改的情况下支持现有同步工具时，在框架中保留发布和完成机制通常更为简单。

sents.zh: 另一种方法是将一个长操作拆分为一个提交工具和状态查询工具。

paragraphs.en: Computationally intensive tools, such as neural networks or GPU-accelerated data processors, can be deployed on computers with suitable hardware and HTTP connectivity to the computer hosting the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 计算密集型工具（例如神经网络或经 GPU 加速的数据处理器）可以部署在具备合适硬件且能与托管 harness 的计算机建立 HTTP 连接的计算机上。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the compute load from other activities on the beamline computer, consider using an edge computing device, such as an NVIDIA DGX Spark. The tool should still be exposed as an MCP server to maximize compatibility with agent harnesses. If the tool returns images, follow the recommendations in Section 3.1.3 . If the tool does not perform instrument control, the asynchronous-execution and thread-safety requirements can be relaxed, and the MCP frontend and compute backend do not necessarily need to be separated into two processes as described in Section 3.2.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了将计算负载与光束线计算机上的其他活动隔离开来，可以考虑使用边缘计算设备，例如 NVIDIA DGX Spark。 该工具仍应作为 MCP 服务器提供，以最大限度地与智能体框架兼容。 如果该工具返回图像，请遵循第 3.1.3 节中的建议。 如果该工具不执行仪器控制，则非同步执行和线程安全要求可以放宽，并且 MCP 前端和计算后端不必像第 3.2.2 节中所述那样必须分离为两个进程。

paragraphs.en: The ALCF hosts several foundation models on its Sophia high-performance-computing system [ 13 ] , including the general-purpose, prompt-based image segmentation model SAM3 . If image segmentation is needed to support beamline experiments, consider using this service instead of deploying a separate inference instance.

paragraphs.en: As a concrete example, the 26-ID nanoprobe deployment described in Section 4.1.1 offloads its segmentation inference to the SAM3 endpoint hosted by the ALCF. A thin SAM3 client on a computer with public network access sends requests to a SAM3 inference server running on the ALCF; results are written to file-exchange storage and picked up by the local tool server. This pattern—light client on the beamline, heavy compute off-site, shared file system as the handoff—generalizes to any compute-bound tool that does not directly drive hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一个具体示例，第 4.1.1 节中描述的 26-ID 纳米探针部署将其分割推理任务外包给由 ALCF 托管的 SAM3 端点。 一台具有公网访问权限的计算机上运行的轻量级 SAM3 客户端会向运行在 ALCF 上的 SAM3 推理服务器发送请求；结果会被写入文件交换存储，并由本地工具服务器获取。 这种模式——束流线上部署轻量级客户端、将重型计算外包至异地、使用共享文件系统作为交接媒介——可以推广到任何不直接控制硬件的计算密集型工具。

paragraphs.en: Agent harnesses commonly maintain continuity across stateless inference calls by supplying previous messages as part of each request. For a specialized experimental workflow, an alternative is to construct the context from a structured record of the information needed by subsequent decisions. This approach is suitable when the relevant experimental state can be represented explicitly, whereas workflows involving open-ended user interactions or heterogeneous tool use may also require conversation history and detailed tool results. General-purpose harnesses can combine these representations according to the task. As discussed in Section 3.1.1 , retaining session information provides continuity without constituting lifecycle learning.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体运行器通常通过将先前消息作为每次请求的一部分提供，从而在无状态推理调用之间保持连续性。 对于专门的实验工作流程，另一种方法是根据后续决策所需信息的结构化记录来构建上下文。 当相关的实验状态能够被明确表示时，这种方法适用；而对于涉及开放式用户交互或使用异构工具的工作流程，可能还需要对话历史和详细的工具结果。 通用型运行器可以根据任务需求将这些表示形式结合起来。 如第 3.1.1 节所述，保留会话信息可以在不引发生命周期学习的情况下保持连续性。

paragraphs.en: In the X-ray fluorescence region-of-interest finder deployed at the Bionanoprobe, we retain the experimental intent, validated control values, selected feedback events, and identifiers of processed scans. Each of the six model jobs in the loop—context interpretation, feedback interpretation, cascade-depth decision, result review, voter evaluation, and box refinement—receives a compact rendering of this record, including the current controls and the last ten events, each capped at a few hundred characters. This representation makes the retained experimental state available across the specialized jobs without requiring each job to receive the complete interaction transcript. Its adequacy depends on whether the retained fields capture the information required by the workflow; constraints or observations omitted from the record are unavailable to later decisions unless supplied separately. An example record is shown below:
paragraphs.zh: 在部署于 Bionanoprobe 的 X 射线荧光感兴趣区域查找器中，我们保留了实验意图、经过验证的控制值、选定的反馈事件以及已处理扫描的标识符。 循环中的六个模型任务——上下文解释、反馈解释、级联深度决策、结果审查、投票者评估和框图优化——每个任务都会收到该记录的精简呈现，包括当前控制设置和最近十次事件，每项内容均限制在数百个字符以内。 这种表示方式使得保留的实验状态可在各个专用任务间共享，而无需每个任务都接收完整的交互记录。 其充分性取决于所保留的字段是否涵盖了工作流程所需的信息；若记录中遗漏了某些约束或观察结果，除非另行提供，否则后续决策将无法使用这些信息。 一个示例记录如下所示：

paragraphs.en: The harness persists the structured record to support recovery after a restart and reuse with the fallback inference endpoint described in Section 3.1.2 . Control updates are validated before storage, and the file is replaced atomically after each event, with the event recording the post-change controls. The resume path ( --resume-session ) restores intent, controls, and recorded history, while processed-scan identifiers allow the workflow to skip scans already recorded as completed. These mechanisms preserve the explicitly recorded state, but do not guarantee equivalent model behavior across endpoints or recovery of information excluded from the record. The event log also provides provenance for the governed write-back described in Section 3.2.4 and a per-run record for the observability service proposed in Section 5 ; promotion of session information into shared skills or memory remains subject to the evaluation and review described in Section 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 该约束机制会保留结构化记录，以支持重启后的恢复，并允许与第 3.1.2 节中描述的备用推理端点重新使用。 控制更新在存储前会经过验证，每次事件发生后文件会被原子性地替换，同时事件会记录变更后的控制信息。 恢复路径（--resume-session）可还原意图、控制和记录的历史，而 processed-scan 标识符则允许工作流跳过已记录为已完成的分析。 这些机制能够保留明确记录的状态，但无法保证不同端点间模型行为的等效性，也无法恢复记录中未包含的信息。 事件日志还为第 3.2.4 节中描述的受控回写提供了来源追溯，并为第 5 节中提出的可观察性服务提供了每次运行的记录；将会话信息提升至共享技能或记忆仍取决于第 2 节中描述的评价与审查。

paragraphs.en: Context construction also affects inference efficiency. Although bounding the rendered record limits its contribution to input length, repeatedly rewriting an early prompt block can reduce prefix-cache reuse on endpoints that support prompt caching. Stable instructions and tool definitions should therefore precede changing session information where the API permits. The choice between replaying message history and reconstructing context from structured state should account for information requirements, input length, cache reuse, and measured latency or cost.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文构建也会影响推理效率。 虽然限制渲染记录可以将其对输入长度的影响降至最低，但重复改写早期的提示块可能会降低支持提示缓存的端点中前缀缓存的重用率。 因此，在 API 允许的情况下，稳定的指令和工具定义应置于可变化的会话信息之前。 在重播消息历史与根据结构化状态重构上下文之间做出选择时，应考虑信息需求、输入长度、缓存重用以及实测的延迟或成本。

paragraphs.en: An instrument-control agent must be treated as a fallible operator rather than as a safety controller. Prompts and skills can describe constraints, but these instructions do not constitute enforceable safety boundaries because the model may interpret or apply them incorrectly. We therefore recommend defense in depth, in which every requested action passes through controls that are independent of the model’s behavior. Physical travel ranges, velocity and acceleration limits, forbidden combinations of instrument states, shutter and detector interlocks, exposure bounds, and command-rate limits should be enforced in firmware or the EPICS/Bluesky control layer whenever possible and otherwise in deterministic tool code. A request outside the permitted operating envelope should fail closed before it reaches the hardware, while existing machine-protection systems and immediate operator override remain authoritative.
paragraphs.zh: 仪器控制智能体必须被视为可能出错的操作员，而非安全控制器。 提示词和技能可以描述约束条件，但这些指令并不构成可强制执行的安全边界，因为模型可能会错误地解释或应用它们。 因此，我们建议采用纵深防御策略，即所有请求的操作都必须经过与模型行为无关的控制机制。 物理移动范围、速度和加速度限制、仪器状态的禁止组合、快门和探测器联锁装置、曝光界限以及命令速率限制，应尽可能在固件或 EPICS/Bluesky 控制层中强制执行，否则应在确定性工具代码中实现。 任何超出允许操作范围的请求都应在到达硬件之前被拒绝，同时现有的机器保护系统和操作员即时覆盖机制仍具有最高权威。

sents.en: A request outside the permitted operating envelope should fail closed before it reaches the hardware, while existing machine-protection systems and immediate operator override remain authoritative.

paragraphs.en: Deterministic procedures should likewise be represented as executable interfaces rather than as prompt-only instructions. A repeated calibration, acquisition, or recovery workflow should be wrapped as a high-level tool, a validated external API, or a tested script distributed with a skill. The agent then selects the routine and supplies bounded parameters, while program logic determines the low-level sequence of operations. For instrument-control procedures, scripts distributed with skills should call the same access-controlled tool or control interface as the harness; they should not open independent EPICS connections or generate direct EPICS or Bluesky commands that bypass these controls. The available interfaces should expose only the allowlisted tools, plans, devices, and PVs required for the agent’s role, with read and write permissions separated where practical. This design preserves the value of a skill as documentation and orchestration without making compliance with its text the only protection against an unsafe action. An additional safety guardrail could come from the control system layer. A dedicated EPICS gateway configured for agent use can expose a named subset of process variables (PVs) read-only by default and grant write access only to the channels a particular workflow requires. Because the gateway sits between the agent host and the control system, the restriction holds regardless of which harness, tool server, or script is running, and it cannot be lifted by a change to agent code or by a skill that opens its own connection. A dedicated gateway instance also gives the facility a natural place to log and rate-limit agent traffic separately from ordinary client traffic. This makes the gateway the most robust point at which to draw the read/write boundary, with tool-level checks serving as a second layer rather than the only one.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性流程同样应以可执行接口的形式呈现，而非仅作为提示指令。 重复的校准、获取或恢复工作流程应封装为高级工具、经过验证的外部 API，或与技能一同分发的测试脚本。 智能体随后选择该流程并提供有限参数，而程序逻辑则决定低级别的操作序列。 对于仪器控制流程，与技能一同分发的脚本应调用与运行环境相同的受控访问工具或控制接口；它们不应打开独立的 EPICS 连接，也不应生成绕过这些控制的直接 EPICS 或 Bluesky 命令。 可用接口应仅暴露智能体角色所需的白名单工具、计划、设备和 PV，并在可行的情况下将读权限和写权限分开。 这种设计保留了技能作为文档和协调机制的价值，同时避免使其文本的合规性成为防止不安全操作的唯一保障。 控制系统的另一层安全护栏也可以提供额外保护。 为智能体使用而配置的专用 EPICS 网关可以默认以只读方式暴露一组命名的过程变量（PV），并仅向特定工作流程所需的通道授予写权限。 由于该网关位于智能体主机与控制系统之间，因此无论运行的是哪个运行环境、工具服务器或脚本，这一限制始终有效，且无法通过修改智能体代码或由技能自行打开连接来解除。 专用的网关实例还能为机构提供一个自然的位置，用于将智能体流量与普通客户端流量分开记录并实施速率限制。 这使得网关成为划定读/写边界的最佳位置，而工具级别的检查则作为第二层防护，而非唯一防护。

sents.en: Deterministic procedures should likewise be represented as executable interfaces rather than as prompt-only instructions.
sents.zh: 确定性流程同样应以可执行接口的形式呈现，而非仅作为提示指令。

sents.en: A repeated calibration, acquisition, or recovery workflow should be wrapped as a high-level tool, a validated external API, or a tested script distributed with a skill.
sents.zh: 重复的校准、获取或恢复工作流程应封装为高级工具、经过验证的外部 API，或与技能一同分发的测试脚本。

sents.en: The agent then selects the routine and supplies bounded parameters, while program logic determines the low-level sequence of operations.
sents.zh: 智能体随后选择该流程并提供有限参数，而程序逻辑则决定低级别的操作序列。

sents.en: For instrument-control procedures, scripts distributed with skills should call the same access-controlled tool or control interface as the harness; they should not open independent EPICS connections or generate direct EPICS or Bluesky commands that bypass these controls.
sents.zh: 对于仪器控制流程，与技能一同分发的脚本应调用与运行环境相同的受控访问工具或控制接口；它们不应打开独立的 EPICS 连接，也不应生成绕过这些控制的直接 EPICS 或 Bluesky 命令。

sents.en: The available interfaces should expose only the allowlisted tools, plans, devices, and PVs required for the agent’s role, with read and write permissions separated where practical.
sents.zh: 可用接口应仅暴露智能体角色所需的白名单工具、计划、设备和 PV，并在可行的情况下将读权限和写权限分开。

sents.en: This design preserves the value of a skill as documentation and orchestration without making compliance with its text the only protection against an unsafe action.
sents.zh: 这种设计保留了技能作为文档和协调机制的价值，同时避免使其文本的合规性成为防止不安全操作的唯一保障。

sents.en: An additional safety guardrail could come from the control system layer.
sents.zh: 控制系统的另一层安全护栏也可以提供额外保护。

sents.en: A dedicated EPICS gateway configured for agent use can expose a named subset of process variables (PVs) read-only by default and grant write access only to the channels a particular workflow requires.
sents.zh: 为智能体使用而配置的专用 EPICS 网关可以默认以只读方式暴露一组命名的过程变量（PV），并仅向特定工作流程所需的通道授予写权限。

sents.en: Because the gateway sits between the agent host and the control system, the restriction holds regardless of which harness, tool server, or script is running, and it cannot be lifted by a change to agent code or by a skill that opens its own connection.
sents.zh: 由于该网关位于智能体主机与控制系统之间，因此无论运行的是哪个运行环境、工具服务器或脚本，这一限制始终有效，且无法通过修改智能体代码或由技能自行打开连接来解除。

sents.en: A dedicated gateway instance also gives the facility a natural place to log and rate-limit agent traffic separately from ordinary client traffic.
sents.zh: 专用的网关实例还能为机构提供一个自然的位置，用于将智能体流量与普通客户端流量分开记录并实施速率限制。

sents.en: This makes the gateway the most robust point at which to draw the read/write boundary, with tool-level checks serving as a second layer rather than the only one.
sents.zh: 这使得网关成为划定读/写边界的最佳位置，而工具级别的检查则作为第二层防护，而非唯一防护。

paragraphs.en: Least-privilege execution must also extend to the host computer and connected services. Agent-generated code and third-party extensions should run under a dedicated unprivileged account and within an environment that exposes only the resources required by the workflow. On Linux, Bubblewrap can construct a mount namespace in which only selected parts of the file system are visible [ 14 ] ; experiment inputs can be mounted read-only, while writes are restricted to designated scratch and output directories. Because Bubblewrap provides isolation mechanisms rather than a complete security policy, its namespace and mount configuration should itself be treated as security-relevant deployment code. Individual tool servers may instead run in containers, and the entire harness can be containerized when the agent requires general shell or code-execution capabilities. In either case, the deployment should mount only the required files, devices, and control sockets; apply appropriate limits to processes, memory, and compute time; and permit network access only to approved inference, tool, and data services. Credentials should remain in the service or tool that needs them whenever possible, rather than being exposed to the agent. Local services can bind to a loopback or private interface, while remote calls should be authenticated and authorized. These measures limit the consequences of erroneous code execution, but they do not replace access controls and safety interlocks at the instrument.
paragraphs.zh: 最小权限执行也必须扩展到主机计算机和连接的服务。 智能体生成的代码和第三方扩展程序应在专用的非特权账户下运行，并处于一个仅暴露工作流所需资源的环境中。 在 Linux 系统中，Bubblewrap 可以构建一个挂载命名空间，其中仅可见文件系统的特定部分 [14]；实验输入可以以只读方式挂载，而写入操作则限制在指定的临时和输出目录中。 由于 Bubblewrap 提供的是隔离机制而非完整的安全策略，其命名空间和挂载配置本身应被视为具有安全重要性的部署代码。 作为替代方案，单个工具服务器可以在容器中运行，而当智能体需要通用 shell 或代码执行能力时，整个框架也可以容器化。 无论采用哪种方式，部署时都只应挂载所需的文件、设备和控制套接字；对进程、内存和计算时间施加适当的限制；并且仅允许访问经批准的推理、工具和数据服务。 凭证应尽可能保留在需要它们的服务或工具中，而不是暴露给智能体。 本地服务可以绑定到回环接口或私有接口，而远程调用则应经过身份验证和授权。 这些措施可以限制错误代码执行带来的后果，但它们不能替代设备层面的访问控制和安全联锁机制。

sents.zh: 最小权限执行也必须扩展到主机计算机和连接的服务。

sents.zh: 本地服务可以绑定到回环接口或私有接口，而远程调用则应经过身份验证和授权。

sents.zh: 这些措施可以限制错误代码执行带来的后果，但它们不能替代设备层面的访问控制和安全联锁机制。

paragraphs.en: Resource isolation alone does not prevent two legitimate clients from commanding the same instrument at the same time. Every state-changing access path should therefore participate in a common lock, implemented in the tool or control layer and preferably enforced at the closest point shared by agents, GUIs, notebooks, and automation scripts. Only the caller that holds the lock should be permitted to actuate the protected instrument; competing requests should be rejected or queued until the lock is released. The lock should record its owner and scope, expire safely if the holder fails, and support explicit release and operator revocation. Harness-level guards remain useful for preventing parallel calls within one agent session, but they cannot protect against a second client that bypasses the harness. The single-operation RunEngine used by the Bluesky Queue Server, discussed below, provides this serialization for requests that pass through the Queue Server. However, direct EPICS clients remain outside that boundary unless the lock is also enforced in the common control layer or firmware.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠资源隔离并不能防止两个合法客户端同时控制同一台仪器。 因此，所有导致状态变化的访问路径都应参与一个公共锁的机制；该锁应实现于工具层或控制层，并尽可能在最接近智能体、图形用户界面（GUI）、笔记本和自动化脚本共享的节点处强制执行。 只有持有锁的调用者才应被允许操作受保护的仪器；竞争请求应被拒绝或排队等待，直到锁被释放。 该锁应记录其所有者和作用域，在持有者发生故障时安全失效，并支持显式释放和由操作员撤销。 Harness 级别的防护机制对于防止同一智能体会话内的并行调用仍然有用，但它们无法防范绕过 Harness 的第二个客户端。 下文将讨论的 Bluesky Queue Server 所使用的单操作 RunEngine，为通过 Queue Server 的请求提供了这种串行化保障。 然而，除非在公共控制层或固件中也强制执行该锁，否则直接的 EPICS 客户端仍会处于这一边界之外。

sents.zh: 仅靠资源隔离并不能防止两个合法客户端同时控制同一台仪器。
