paragraphs.en: The accelerator does, however, lack the structural separation that organizes the beamline side of Fig. 1 . There is a single control system of a few million channels, and no natural per-instrument boundary along which to partition tool servers, skill sets, or approval policy. An agent acting on the machine acts on the one object that every beamline depends on. The mitigation is gated write authority rather than isolation. The large majority of the deployment is read-only, including archiver retrieval, channel discovery, and analysis. Where writes are permitted, it is checked against a whitelist of allowed channels and per-channel limits, with the write mode set per deployment. At the APS , actuation is currently confined to well-scoped measurement procedures such as the injector scan mentioned above. Concurrency control is correspondingly looser than on the beamline side, where a Bluesky queue serializes access to an instrument. There is no equivalent single queueing authority for the machine, and the platform does not yet arbitrate between agents contending for the same subsystem. With write access restricted as described this has not been a practical limitation, but explicit arbitration will be needed as autonomy and the number of concurrent sessions grow.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，该加速器确实缺乏将图 1 中的束线部分组织起来的结构性分离。 它只有一个包含数百万通道的控制系统，并且没有天然的按设备划分的边界，无法据此对工具服务器、技能集或审批策略进行划分。 作用于机器的智能体实际上是在作用于束线所依赖的唯一对象。 缓解措施是通过权限控制写入操作，而非实现隔离。 部署中的绝大多数操作都是只读的，包括归档数据检索、通道发现和数据分析。 在允许写入的地方，系统会依据白名单检查允许的通道和每个通道的限制，并且写入模式由每次部署单独设置。 在 APS，当前的操作仅限于范围明确的测量程序，例如上文提到的注入器扫描。 因此，并发控制也比束线侧更为宽松；在束线侧，Bluesky 队列会串行化对设备的访问。 机器目前并没有一个等效的单一排队授权机制，平台也尚未能在争夺同一子系统的智能体之间进行仲裁。 由于写入权限如前所述受到限制，这目前并未构成实际限制；但随着自主性和并发会话数量的增加，将需要明确的仲裁机制。

paragraphs.en: The single decision that has paid off most consistently is decoupling the agent harness from the instrument-control tools. We have swapped LLM endpoints, swapped harnesses, and modified skill sets repeatedly without touching the instrument-control code on the worker side. MCP and skills have provided a durable interoperability layer: tools written for one harness have been reusable in others with little or no modification. This architectural portability is necessary but not sufficient. Production systems should ultimately be evaluated by the quality and reproducibility of the scientific decisions they support, the time required to obtain interpretable evidence, the transfer of knowledge between users, and the operator time they free for scientific questions, rather than by throughput alone.
paragraphs.zh: 迄今为止最稳定、回报最高的单一决策，是将智能体框架与工具控制工具解耦。 我们多次更换了 LLM 端点、更换了框架，并反复修改技能集，但从未改动过工作端工具控制的代码。 MCP 和技能提供了一层持久的互操作性：为某个框架编写的工具，几乎无需修改即可在其他框架中重复使用。 这种架构上的可移植性是必要的，但还不够充分。 生产系统最终应通过其所支持的科学决策的质量与可重复性、获取可解释证据所需的时间、用户间的知识传递，以及其为科学问题节省的操作员时间来进行评估，而不应仅凭吞吐量来评判。

paragraphs.en: For the extensions in Sections 3.4 – 3.6 , evaluation should follow the chain from observation to accepted outcome. Relevant measures include evidence coverage, diagnostic correctness, time to a supported finding, operator effort, recovery verified at the affected service, and appropriate escalation. Knowledge reuse should be assessed for source support, temporal applicability, and preservation of access boundaries, including tests in which sources are corrected or workers resume with stale state. These are proposed evaluation dimensions, not measured results of a facility-wide autonomous deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 对于第 3.4 – 3.6 节中的扩展部分，评估应遵循从观察到被接受结果的流程。 相关指标包括证据覆盖范围、诊断准确性、得出支持性发现所需的时间、操作员的努力程度、受影响服务中已验证的恢复情况以及适当的升级措施。 知识复用应评估其来源支持性、时间适用性以及访问边界的保留情况，包括在来源被修正或工作者使用过时状态继续工作的测试。 这些是建议的评估维度，而非整个设施自主部署的测量结果。

paragraphs.en: The most foundational missing piece is the MCP /Skills Hub itself. The central gateway in Fig. 1 is depicted as the spine of the architecture but does not yet exist. We aim to design and operate the hub in a lightweight, user-friendly way:
paragraphs.zh: 最基础但缺失的关键环节，正是 MCP /Skills Hub 本身。 图 1 中的中央网关被描绘为架构的核心支柱，但目前尚未存在。 我们的目标是，以轻量且用户友好的方式设计和运营该枢纽：

sents.en: The most foundational missing piece is the MCP /Skills Hub itself.
sents.zh: 最基础但缺失的关键环节，正是 MCP /Skills Hub 本身。

sents.en: The central gateway in Fig. 1 is depicted as the spine of the architecture but does not yet exist.
sents.zh: 图 1 中的中央网关被描绘为架构的核心支柱，但目前尚未存在。

sents.en: We aim to design and operate the hub in a lightweight, user-friendly way:
sents.zh: 我们的目标是，以轻量且用户友好的方式设计和运营该枢纽：

paragraphs.en: A GitHub organization will be created to host the source code and documentation for tool servers and skills. Each tool or skill will have its own repository.
paragraphs.zh: 将创建一个 GitHub 组织，用于托管工具服务器和技能的源代码及文档。 每个工具或技能都将拥有自己的仓库。

sents.en: A GitHub organization will be created to host the source code and documentation for tool servers and skills.
sents.zh: 将创建一个 GitHub 组织，用于托管工具服务器和技能的源代码及文档。

sents.en: Each tool or skill will have its own repository.
sents.zh: 每个工具或技能都将拥有自己的仓库。

paragraphs.en: On top of that, we will develop a lightweight website resembling SkillsMP ( https://skillsmp.com/ ) to serve as a catalog of tools and skills. The website will not hold the code or documents directly, but will link to the corresponding GitHub repositories. The website should:
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们将开发一个类似于 SkillsMP（https://skillsmp.com/）的轻量级网站，用作工具和技能的目录。 该网站不会直接存放代码或文档，而是会链接到相应的 GitHub 仓库。该网站应：

sents.en: On top of that, we will develop a lightweight website resembling SkillsMP ( https://skillsmp.com/ ) to serve as a catalog of tools and skills.
sents.zh: 此外，我们将开发一个类似于 SkillsMP（https://skillsmp.com/）的轻量级网站，用作工具和技能的目录。

sents.en: The website will not hold the code or documents directly, but will link to the corresponding GitHub repositories. The website should:
sents.zh: 该网站不会直接存放代码或文档，而是会链接到相应的 GitHub 仓库。该网站应：

paragraphs.en: Allow users to browse or search for tools and skills by name or functional tag ( e.g. , microprobe , database , or ptychography )
paragraphs.zh: 允许用户通过名称或功能标签（例如，微探针、数据库或ptychography）浏览或搜索工具和技能。

paragraphs.en: Provide installation and deployment instructions specific to each tool or skill
paragraphs.zh: 提供针对每种工具或技能的特定安装和部署说明

paragraphs.en: Expose API endpoints and agent-friendly documentation that allow AI agents to search for, download, install, and deploy tools and skills.
paragraphs.zh: 提供可供访问的 API 端点和适合智能体的文档，使 AI 智能体能够搜索、下载、安装和部署工具与技能。

paragraphs.en: To protect the integrity of skill and MCP repositories and prevent unauthorized changes, we will take the following measures:
paragraphs.zh: 为保护技能和 MCP 存储库的完整性并防止未经授权的更改，我们将采取以下措施：

paragraphs.en: The catalog website will be hosted inside the Argonne network and will not be publicly accessible.
paragraphs.zh: 该目录网站将托管在阿贡网络内部，并且不会向公众开放访问。

paragraphs.en: Each catalog entry will point to a specific commit or release tag rather than to a mutable repository branch. Updates will require an authenticated request through Argonne’s single sign-on service, followed by administrator audit and approval. This process ensures that the reviewed version remains unchanged until a replacement is explicitly promoted.
paragraphs.zh: 每个目录条目都将指向特定的提交或发布标签，而不是指向可变的仓库分支。 更新需要通过阿贡实验室的单点登录服务进行身份验证的请求，随后由管理员进行审核和批准。 此流程确保经过审核的版本在明确推广替换之前保持不变。

sents.en: Each catalog entry will point to a specific commit or release tag rather than to a mutable repository branch.
sents.zh: 每个目录条目都将指向特定的提交或发布标签，而不是指向可变的仓库分支。

sents.en: Updates will require an authenticated request through Argonne’s single sign-on service, followed by administrator audit and approval.
sents.zh: 更新需要通过阿贡实验室的单点登录服务进行身份验证的请求，随后由管理员进行审核和批准。

sents.en: This process ensures that the reviewed version remains unchanged until a replacement is explicitly promoted.
sents.zh: 此流程确保经过审核的版本在明确推广替换之前保持不变。

paragraphs.en: The runtime control-plane extension should proceed separately from catalog publication. A staged integration can first expose read-only inventory, operational observations, and knowledge retrieval through common identity and result contracts, then add reviewable change proposals, and only subsequently admit authorized execution for selected procedures. Before a cross-domain workflow is enabled, each participating service should define its action scope, failure and cancellation behavior, arbitration boundary, and acceptance evidence. Shared memory should be introduced with the provenance and revision controls in Section 3.5 . This sequence allows useful diagnostic assistance before broad write authority is available and does not require replacing the existing service backends.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时控制平面扩展应与目录发布分开进行。 分阶段集成可以先通过通用身份和结果契约，暴露只读的库存信息、运行观察结果和知识检索功能，然后加入可审查的变更提案，最后才允许对选定的程序执行授权操作。 在启用跨域工作流之前，每个参与的服务都应明确其操作范围、故障与取消行为、仲裁边界以及接受证据。 共享内存的引入应结合第 3.5 节中的来源和版本控制机制。 这一流程可在授予广泛写入权限之前提供有效的诊断支持，且无需替换现有的服务后端。

sents.en: The runtime control-plane extension should proceed separately from catalog publication.
sents.zh: 运行时控制平面扩展应与目录发布分开进行。

sents.en: A staged integration can first expose read-only inventory, operational observations, and knowledge retrieval through common identity and result contracts, then add reviewable change proposals, and only subsequently admit authorized execution for selected procedures.
sents.zh: 分阶段集成可以先通过通用身份和结果契约，暴露只读的库存信息、运行观察结果和知识检索功能，然后加入可审查的变更提案，最后才允许对选定的程序执行授权操作。

sents.en: Before a cross-domain workflow is enabled, each participating service should define its action scope, failure and cancellation behavior, arbitration boundary, and acceptance evidence.
sents.zh: 在启用跨域工作流之前，每个参与的服务都应明确其操作范围、故障与取消行为、仲裁边界以及接受证据。

sents.en: Shared memory should be introduced with the provenance and revision controls in Section 3.5 .
sents.zh: 共享内存的引入应结合第 3.5 节中的来源和版本控制机制。

sents.en: This sequence allows useful diagnostic assistance before broad write authority is available and does not require replacing the existing service backends.
sents.zh: 这一流程可在授予广泛写入权限之前提供有效的诊断支持，且无需替换现有的服务后端。

paragraphs.en: Once the hub is operational, its four capability categories can be populated in parallel. Knowledge retrieval is the capability most readily available today. The APS retrieval-augmented-generation service (APS-RAG; https://rag.aps.anl.gov/ ) [ 19 ] already searches machine logbooks, experiment and configuration records, work requests, operations discussions, technical reports, and other operational applications. The source of machine logbooks is Best Electronic Logbook Yet (BELY) . Registering this service as an MCP tool would make these sources available without requiring users to know the internal names of the underlying systems. However, knowledge exchange should not remain one-way. Corrections from scientists, annotated outcomes, and agent-proposed procedures should enter a governed write-back queue that records the source evidence, conditions of applicability, and review status before the information is promoted to durable facility knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦枢纽投入运行，其四个能力类别便可并行填充。 知识检索是当今最容易实现的能力。 APS 检索增强生成服务（APS-RAG；https://rag.aps.anl.gov/）[19] 已经能够搜索机器日志簿、实验和配置记录、工作请求、操作讨论、技术报告以及其他运营应用。 机器日志簿的来源是“最佳电子日志簿”（BELY）。 将此服务注册为 MCP 工具，将使用户无需了解底层系统的内部名称即可访问这些资源。 然而，知识交换不应是单向的。 科学家的修正、带注释的结果以及智能体提出的流程应进入一个受管理的回写队列，在信息被提升为持久化设施知识之前，记录其来源证据、适用条件及审核状态。

paragraphs.en: Instrument control requires a shared skill registry so that a procedure validated at one beamline can be discovered, reviewed, and reused at another without being developed again. For instruments with an existing Bluesky deployment, BITS provides a uniform device registry and Queue Server interface, while BAIT MCP provides the corresponding tool-server entry point.
paragraphs.zh: 仪器控制需要一个共享的技能注册表，这样在一条光束线上经过验证的流程，就能在另一条光束线上被发现、审查和重复使用，而无需重新开发。 对于已有 Bluesky 部署的仪器，BITS 提供了一个统一的设备注册表和队列服务器接口，而 BAIT MCP 则提供了相应的工具服务器入口点。

paragraphs.en: A first instance of such a registry is already starting to take shape on the accelerator side. The effort described in Section 4.2 has established a marketplace of shared accelerator skills, populated by workflows that were validated in operation and then packaged for one-sentence reuse. It serves the same function as the Skills Hub in Fig. 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 此类注册表的首个实例已在加速器端开始成形。 第 4.2 节中描述的工作已建立了一个共享加速器技能的市场，其中包含经过实际验证后被打包用于单句重用的工作流。 它与图 1 中的技能中心具有相同的功能。

paragraphs.en: The analysis and computing capability is also partially in place because EAA offloads SAM3 inference and Pty-Chi reconstruction to Polaris at the ALCF. These services should be made available through the hub so that other harnesses can access them through a common interface. In addition, a cross-cutting observability service should record tool calls, reasoning traces, evidence, and confirmed human overrides in a common, queryable format. The Hutch package [ 20 ] is a first step in this direction.
paragraphs.zh: 分析能力和计算能力也部分具备，因为 EAA 将 SAM3 推理和 Pty-Chi 重建任务卸载到 ALCF 的 Polaris 上。 这些服务应通过中心枢纽提供，以便其他工具集能够通过统一接口访问它们。 此外，一项跨领域的可观察性服务应以统一且支持查询的格式记录工具调用、推理轨迹、证据以及经确认的人工覆盖操作。 Hutch 包 [ 20 ] 是朝这个方向迈出的第一步。

paragraphs.en: We intend the beamline and accelerator catalogs to cross-reference one another. Treating these systems as a unified framework enables complex, automated workflows where beamline users gain selective local control over specific accelerator parameters. For instance, users could implement local orbit bumps directly or query real-time accelerator diagnostics to correlate beam performance with X-ray-based experimental measurements. Their contents generalize in different directions. A beamline skill often transfers to another beamline with a similar experimental setup, and increasingly to a comparable instrument at another facility, so the natural scope for that catalog is the technique rather than the site. What the two do share is a set of capability classes, including channel discovery, archiver retrieval, logbook and document search, plot generation, and the observability and provenance services described above. Cross-referencing matters for questions that span both domains, such as beam stability at a source point or drift correlated with machine state, where an agent needs to discover a machine-side diagnostic skill and invoke it read-only without inheriting write access to the accelerator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们计划让束流线和加速器目录之间相互交叉引用。 将这些系统视为一个统一框架，可以支持复杂的自动化工作流程，使束流线用户能够针对特定的加速器参数实现选择性的局部控制。 例如，用户可以直接实施局部轨道扰动，或查询实时加速器诊断数据，以将束流性能与基于X射线的实验测量结果进行关联。 它们的内容以不同方向进行泛化。 一种束流线技能通常可以迁移到具有相似实验设置的另一条束流线上，并且越来越多地迁移到其他设施中类似的仪器上，因此该目录的自然范围应聚焦于技术本身，而非具体地点。 两者共同拥有的是一系列能力类别，包括通道发现、归档器检索、日志和文档搜索、图表生成，以及上文描述的观测性和来源追溯服务。 对于跨越这两个领域的问题（例如源点处的束流稳定性或与机器状态相关的漂移），交叉引用至关重要；在这种情况下，智能体需要发现机器侧的诊断技能，并以只读方式调用它，而无需继承对加速器的写入权限。

paragraphs.en: The longer-term opportunity is to increase the scientific value of instruments throughout their operational lifetimes. Agents can perform routine calibration, measurement execution, quality monitoring, and initial data synthesis, while scientists retain authority over experimental goals, uncertainty, anomalies, and interpretation. Knowledge can then flow in both directions: scientists teach procedures and judgment to the system, while the system supports future users by returning explanations, provenance, and lessons accumulated across experiments. Validated lessons can become versioned skills that move between instruments and, eventually, between facilities; unvalidated experiences should remain isolated as candidate knowledge. Specific implementations will change, but separability, safety, provenance, human authority, and governed learning will remain durable requirements. Success should therefore be measured not only by throughput, but also by reproducibility, access, the time required to obtain trustworthy evidence, and the quality of the scientific decisions that the system enables.
paragraphs.zh: 更长期的机遇在于，在整个运行生命周期内提升仪器的科学价值。 智能体可以执行常规校准、测量操作、质量监控和初步数据合成，而科学家则保留对实验目标、不确定性、异常现象和结果解释的最终决定权。 这样，知识就可以双向流动：科学家将操作流程和判断经验传授给系统，而系统则通过返回解释、来源信息以及跨实验积累的经验教训，为未来的使用者提供支持。 经过验证的经验教训可以转化为可版本化的技能，在不同仪器之间，乃至最终在不同设施之间共享；未经验证的经验则应作为候选知识保持独立。 具体实现方式会发生变化，但可分离性、安全性、来源追溯性、人类决策权以及受控学习将始终是不可改变的核心要求。 因此，成功与否不应仅以处理量来衡量，还应包括可重复性、可访问性、获取可靠证据所需的时间，以及系统所支持的科学决策质量。
